ui.xmas_deer.event.unlock.title: Christmas Cart
ui.xmas_deer.event.unlock.text: Defend all the Christmas reindeer to find your present in the cart.
ui.raven.speech.0: Woah! Hold on. Lower your weapon. It's the holiday season! I've come to offer a lucrative trade. Will you hear me out?
ui.raven.speech.1: Well, um... can you collect a bunch of stockings for me? You heard right. You know, special festive ones. Bring me a few from the Frozen Treasures. The more, the better.
ui.raven.speech.2: Your neighbors hung stockings on their trees and think some spirits will put presents in them. Those morons won't get anything. They'll all be mine! I mean... I'll share some with you, too.
ui.raven.speech.3: There are special stockings in the dungeon's secret room. Bring them to me and be free. I'll offer you this fearsome weapon as a reward for you to hurry up and get going.
ui.raven.speech.4: You think the spirits will put coal in my stockings instead of presents? I'm fine with that—coal is worth way more than toys in the Plaguelands. Ha-ha!
ui.goblin_xmas.title: Greedy Alchemist
ui.goblin_xmas.speech.0: Let's not fight! I have a good deal to offer you. In the spirit of the holidays, of course. Interested?
ui.goblin_xmas.speech.1: Do you know what Cinnabar is? It's these rocks... beautiful rocks... you can find them in Frozen Treasures. Will you bring them to me?
ui.goblin_xmas.speech.2: I saw an old man in a red outfit on my way here. Ho-ho, his pockets are probably stuffed with cinnabar. Take it all from him and I will reward you.
ui.goblin_xmas.speech.3: That's good, but I need more! You know where else you can find more red rocks? In the secret room of the dungeon! I'll give you this amazing sword as a reward!
ui.goblin_xmas.speech.4: I'll finally get enough mercury to make a remedy for the Gray Decay. I'm gonna be rich! There'll never be a dearth of buyers in the Plaguelands, that's for sure, ha-ha!

ui.trader.horse_trade.1: You won't find better horses across all of Lubenia. Trade for one, you won't regret it.

ui.trader.horse_trade.4: This one's docile. No worries, though, it'll get you anywhere in the blink of an eye.
ui.trader.horse_trade.5: I'm prepared to relieve you of that old, haggard horse you've got—for cheap, too.
ui.trader.horse_trade.6: I'll say it straight: the horse you're riding – nobody rides those anymore.
ui.trader.horse_trade.7: This horse is straight from the Emperor's stables. I swear by it.
ui.trader.horse_trade.8: I'll only give it away to a good owner. You'll look after it, right?

ui.hw_hugin.speech.0: This may sound weird, but the feathers on my armor have lost all their color—and the coming celebration is all about costumes. Bring me Raven Feathers and I'll owe you a favor.
ui.hw_hugin.speech.1: The Grim Mansion is a terrifying and dangerous place, but the rewards are worth the risk. Search for feathers in that dark place.
ui.hw_hugin.speech.2: The henchmen of death itself hide in the Dungeon's Secret Room. Find it and return my feathers to me.
ui.hw_hugin.speech.3: The Ghost Sword is a weapon of darkness, but you can wield it to your benefit. I'll give it to you if you help me.
ui.hw_hugin.speech.4: This shield is my most precious possession. Bring me the last feathers I need and it will be yours.
ui.hw_hugin.speech.5: Thank you for your help. It may seem like a triviality to you, but this costume is very important to me.
ui.hw_iven.speech.0: The time has come for the holiday ritual and I need Moonflowers! Help me gather them in return for valuable gifts.
ui.hw_iven.speech.1: The powerful Plague Coven was destroyed some time ago, but its secret caches may still hold Moonflowers.
ui.hw_iven.speech.2: I heard the Forsaken Order hides incredibly valuable trophies in the secret room of their dungeon. You might find some Moonflowers there.
ui.hw_iven.speech.3: The Ghost Sword is a mighty weapon of Shobol, but you can wield it to great personal benefit. I'll give it to you if you help me in my search.
ui.hw_iven.speech.4: It's good when death stands on your side. Bring me more Moonflowers and you will be able to call on the dead to fight with you.
ui.hw_iven.speech.5: We collected enough Moonflowers, thank you for your help.

ui.battlepass.reward_info:
Exiles, the Order of the Scarlet Angels needs your help again!
 
A new threat has emerged in Lubenia.
Restless spirits are spreading through the provinces. We can't pass up this chance, or else the living dead will spread through the lands like wildfire. We must find out who or what is disturbing the dead and put an end to it.
Exiles who help the Order in this fight can expect generous rewards!
May the Light guide us. Happy hunting!

ui.witch_hw_speech.0: Don't be afraid. I've come to talk. Help me collect amanitas for a little ritual... and get special rewards.
ui.witch_hw_speech.1: The best amanitas grow in the Deceased Village not far from here. It is guarded by a gigantic skeleton. Defeat it and pick the mushrooms for my celebratory ritual.
ui.witch_hw_speech.2: It's dangerous for regular people to go outside when beings from another world are wandering about. I'll help you with the face paint if you bring me more of those marvelous red mushrooms.
ui.witch_hw_speech.3: The Forsaken have a large stockpile of amanitas in the secret room of their dungeon. Perhaps you can find enough mushrooms there?
ui.witch_hw_speech.4: Bring me more amanitas and you can tame the Dead that have returned from the next world...
ui.witch_hw_speech.5: Thank you. Now all the witches will envy my beauty! Heh heh heh!

ui.rupert_xmas_speech.0: Haven't seen you in a while. You've accomplished a lot this year, but I've come with a new challenge. Collect Winter Talismans to save Lubenia from the Fierce Freeze.
ui.rupert_xmas_speech.1: Winter Talismans can be found in various places. Have you encountered the Christmas Cart? Save the reindeer and the talismans are yours. Plus a reward from me.
ui.rupert_xmas_speech.2: I heard the Forsaken have also put up a Christmas tree in a secret room in their dungeon. I bet you can find talismans there, too. Get them quick and I'll give you this wonderful Ice Bow.
ui.rupert_xmas_speech.3: They say a bandit known as Plague Santa has settled in the woods. He's robbed many Exiles, which means he must have tons of Winter Talismans!
ui.rupert_xmas_speech.4: This Ice Scythe is a special weapon. It both freezes your enemies and deals them frost damage. Well, aren't you just itching to try it out?
ui.rupert_xmas_speech.5: Thanks, Exile. I hope we can stop the Fierce Freeze and its mistress, Halt. Good luck in the new year!

ui.battlepass_trader_speech.1: Interesting... and disgusting! But very interesting

ui.night_guests_hw_speech.0: No need to shake and quake! No, no! Bring sweets! Take them from the walking dead in Vilgraw—sweets are too bad for their teeth!
ui.night_guests_hw_speech.1: The Cook is a liar! You can never have too many sweets. There are an awful lot of sweets in dank dungeons! There is even a hidden room, just for sweets! But shhh, it's a super-duper secret.
ui.night_guests_hw_speech.2: Who has the most candy? Those who hit hardest! Essen... Eiser... Eisenborg! And his kind! Bring us their supplies!
ui.night_guests_hw_speech.3: Bring us candy. MORE candy! We have a helmet hat. Magical. Glowing. Wait, no, not glowing! But still pretty. You can have it.
ui.night_guests_hw_speech.4: You're always alone looking grumpy. Don't you have any friends? We'll help and show you how to summon lots of friends! Just run along to the old tomb and find more candy!
ui.night_guests_hw_speech.5: The cook was right! Too much candy—bad. It makes us sad. Our tummies and teeth hurt. No more candy, no from you!

ui.xmas_klaus_2022_speech.0: Ho ho ho! The time of miracles is here, so don't be surprised. You've accomplished a lot this year, but I've come to offer a new challenge. Collect Christmas lanterns to save Lubenia from the Fierce Freeze.
ui.xmas_klaus_2022_speech.1: Christmas lanterns can be found in the most unexpected places. They may be hiding in the mysterious snowdrifts that have started to appear across the province.
ui.xmas_klaus_2022_speech.2: The Cunning Scrooge is sure to have Christmas lanterns, but he's not just going to give them away. You'll have to win them at cards. You can always find this scoundrel at the Camp of Scarlet Angels.
ui.xmas_klaus_2022_speech.3: They say a bandit known as Plague Santa has settled in our area. He's robbed many Exiles, which means he must have tons of Christmas lanterns!
ui.xmas_klaus_2022_speech.4: To defeat the Fierce Freeze, you'll need not only skill but also a fair share of luck! Bring me more Christmas lanterns, and I'll help you with that!
ui.xmas_klaus_2022_speech.5: I heard the Forsaken have also put up a Christmas tree in a secret room on the first floor of their dungeon. I bet you can find lanterns there, too. Hurry!
ui.xmas_klaus_2022_speech.6: You have done much already, but you still have one last push to go. I'll give you a powerful weapon to fight your enemies, but you must bring me more Christmas lanterns.
ui.xmas_klaus_2022_speech.7: Thanks, Exile. I hope we can stop the Fierce Freeze and its mistress, Halt. Good luck in the new year!

ui.popup.putrefaction.text: Starting with update 5.4.0, the bodies of all killed enemies will start to decompose and will disappear after three days. We do not recommend using bodies to store valuable loot.
ui.hw_monster_hunters_2023_speech.0: Exile! You seem to know these lands well. Help us defeat the evil spirits here and receive a valuable reward.
ui.hw_monster_hunters_2023_speech.1: Many enemies have appeared in local forests. Bring us bone powder. Kill Damned, Plagueridden, witches, direwolves, Damned Knights, and Damned Templars.
ui.hw_monster_hunters_2023_speech.2: You may encounter sarcophagi during your travels. Try to look inside them. The ruined town of Vilgraw is nearby as well—many evil spirits can be found there.
ui.hw_monster_hunters_2023_speech.3: Particularly strong evil inhabits the local dungeons. We suggest you look there, too. Rumor has it you can challenge a fallen master himself!
ui.hw_monster_hunters_2023_speech.4: Have you been to the Dungeons of the Forsaken? Legend has it that in the depths of the dungeons lies a secret chamber of treasure. Who knows what you might find there...
ui.hw_monster_hunters_2023_speech.5: You brought many trophies. They say you can find more from the Cunning Scrooge... if you can convince him to part with them.
ui.hw_monster_hunters_2023_speech.6: Time to deal the decisive blow. Complete our last task and receive an artifact as a reward.
ui.hw_monster_hunters_2023_speech.7: You showed your skill well. These lands are calmer now.

ui.rogue_santa_manor_opened.text: The map shows the location of the Plague Santa's Estate. Find out what treasures are hidden behind these walls.
ui.claus_trade_opened.text: The map shows the location of the Commander Claus's Camp. Get special keys and open Christmas gifts!
ui.santa_vs_claus.text: Take part in the battle between Commander Claus and Plague Santa. Help the commander fight off his enemy's attacks.

ui.claus_trade_2023_small_medium_keys.te: Want more keys? Talk to the others!
ui.claus_trade_2023_large_keys.text: Get other keys from my helpers!
ui.map_event_failed.text: A similar location is already marked on your map.
ui.kerr_trade_v600.text.0: The time has come! The Scarlet Angels need your help! It's time to get back the lost relics.
ui.kerr_trade_v600.text.1: You can begin your relic hunt with victims of the Gray Decay. Pay particular attention to the ruins of large settlements!
ui.kerr_trade_v600.text.2: Rumor has it that the Cunning Scrooge possesses several tablets. But you'll have to win them fair and square.
ui.kerr_trade_v600.text.3: Our scouts have managed to track down a necromancer who may possess the relics we need. Try to visit him.
ui.kerr_trade_v600.text.4:
You should have a map of the Forsaken Cache.
I suggest you follow it.
Who knows what the apostates may have stashed away for a rainy day?
ui.kerr_trade_v600.text.5: The Dungeon of the Forsaken is an excellent location to continue the relic hunt. Just stay alert—the dungeon is extremely dangerous.
ui.kerr_trade_v600.text.6: The Dungeon of the Torturers keeps many secrets. Try to locate the secret room. Just remember to stock up on explosives.
ui.kerr_trade_v600.text.7: You've managed to obtain many relics. Keep it up, and the Order will reward you handsomely.
ui.kerr_trade_v600.text.8: Continue the search and bring all the tablets you can find. A fitting reward awaits you!
ui.kerr_trade_v740.text.0: The time has come! The Scarlet Angels need your help! It's time to get back the lost relics.
ui.kerr_trade_v740.text.1: You can begin your relic hunt with victims of the Gray Decay. Pay particular attention to the ruins of large settlements!
ui.kerr_trade_v740.text.2: Rumor has it that the Cunning Scrooge possesses several tablets. But you'll have to win them fair and square.
ui.kerr_trade_v740.text.3: Relics can be found in the most unexpected corners of Lubenia. Explore everything you come across, from ruined camps to abandoned crypts.
ui.kerr_trade_v740.text.4: Want to find even more relics? Talk to our scout—he has maps of the surrounding areas which almost certainly have something interesting on them.
ui.kerr_trade_v740.text.5: The Dungeon of the Forsaken is an excellent location to continue the relic hunt. Just stay alert—the dungeon is extremely dangerous.
ui.kerr_trade_v740.text.6: The Dungeon of the Torturers keeps many secrets. Try to locate the secret room. Just remember to stock up on explosives.
ui.kerr_trade_v740.text.7: You've managed to obtain many relics. Keep it up, and the Order will reward you handsomely.

ui.hw_raven_trade_v666.text.0: Ca-caw! Lots of shinies here. But without keys, you won't reach them, no. You bring me bone powder, I give you the keys. Honest tr-r-rade!
ui.hw_raven_trade_v666.text.1: Go farther and you'll find the entrance to the royal tomb. It's packed with bone powder! And danger-r-r. Be careful, featherless.
ui.hw_raven_trade_v666.text.2: That gambling Scr-r-rooge might bet the thing I need. He's probably staying at this S-caw-let Flappers camp. Visit him.
ui.hw_raven_trade_v666.text.3: Keys don't open every door-r-r. You may need to make something go BOOM! Caw! Look for thin walls, and more shinies will be yours.
ui.hw_raven_trade_v666.text.4: My great-great-grandfather and my entire family line have guarded the secr-r-rets of this tomb. I'm willing to share them with you. But you'll owe me in return.
ui.hw_raven_trade_v666.text.5: Why do I need the powder-r-r? Well, why do you ask so many questions? Great knowledge leads to great sorrow. That's why you've never-r-r seen a happy raven.
ui.hw_raven_trade_v666.text.6: You're doing well for-r-r a featherless one. Maybe your kind isn't totally useless. You just need proper tr-r-raining!
ui.hw_raven_trade_v666.text.7: Did you think that was it? Ca-caw! No, no, I have mor-r-re in store for you. Let's trade until you run out of bone powder!
ui.sepulchre_raven_trade_v740.text.0: Ca-caw! See that dungeon? One of the ancient kings was once buried there. Bring me that reprobate's coins and you'll get a worthwhile reward!
ui.sepulchre_raven_trade_v740.text.1: Some adventurers have already descended into that tomb. Tr-r-ry to enlist their support if you happen to bump into them.
ui.sepulchre_raven_trade_v740.text.2: Know your-r-r enemy! Use fire against ghosts to radically alter the cour-r-rse of battle!
ui.sepulchre_raven_trade_v740.text.3: Fear and fatigue mean nothing to skeletons, but they can be fr-r-rozen. They're literally chilled to the bone! Ca-caw!
ui.sepulchre_raven_trade_v740.text.4: My great-great-grandfather and my entire family line have guarded the secr-r-rets of this tomb. I'm willing to share them with you. But you'll owe me in return.
ui.sepulchre_raven_trade_v740.text.5: What do I need coins for--r-r? Well, why do you ask so many questions? Great knowledge leads to great sorrow. That's why you've never-r-r seen a happy raven.
ui.sepulchre_raven_trade_v740.text.6: You're doing well for-r-r a featherless one. Maybe your kind isn't totally useless. You just need proper tr-r-raining!
ui.sepulchre_raven_trade_v740.text.7: Did you think that was it? Ca-caw! No, no, I have mor-r-re in store for you. Let's trade till you run out of coins!
ui.ancient_sepulchre.text: Scarlet Angels scouts have discovered an Ancient Sepulcher. What treasures do these old walls conceal?
ui.piligrim_trade_v670.text.0: Have you ever come across turkeys? They say they're plentiful at this time of year. Bring me their feathers, and you'll get valuable rewards!
ui.piligrim_trade_v670.text.1: They say direwolves are excellent hunters for turkeys. The Cunning Scrooge's beast has brought many of those birds down. I bet his master has plenty of those feathers stored.
ui.piligrim_trade_v670.text.2: The bigger the turkey, the more feathers you get! Try to catch the attention of their leader. If you hunt those birds for a while, it won't go unnoticed.
ui.piligrim_trade_v670.text.3: Getting close to the Turkey Boss may not be easy. Use cunning—bows, crossbows, traps... Just don't damage the feathers!
ui.piligrim_trade_v670.text.4: Our hunt still isn't over! This time, there's a special reward for you. Come back with feathers.
ui.piligrim_trade_v670.text.5: Let's see what else I have.
ui.piligrim_trade_v670.text.6: I'm ready to trade you all the feathers you can get.
ui.piligrim_trade_v670.text.7: Look what an enormous Food Shelf! You'll have somewhere to keep your stores.
ui.xmas_goblin_village.text: A small village of Plague Elves has been found. Now you know where they've been bringing your treasure all this time.
ui.xmas_shepherd.text:
You've discovered the reindeer pasture. Help the shepherd defend the escaped
deer from predators!
ui.xmas_bags.text: You've discovered the location of the Frozen Treasures. Hurry to reach them before Plague Santa's servants do!
ui.xmas_deer.text:
You've discovered the location of
the ambush on the Christmas Cart.
You need to save the reindeer and protect
the convoy of gifts!
ui.xmas_goblin_torture_chair.no_charges_: The poor thing needs some time. I'll come back later
ui.xmas_goblin_torture_chair.location_co: This location is already marked on my map
ui.xmas_goblin_torture_chair.speech.0: Stop! I'll tell you what Santa did this summer! No more!
ui.xmas_goblin_torture_chair.speech.1: I've made my choice! Aaahh!! No more tickling, I've changed my mind!
ui.xmas_goblin_torture_chair.speech.2: Hah! I could take this all day. What do you mean you haven't started yet?!
ui.xmas_goblin_torture_chair.speech_no_c: *The Plague Elf is unconscious. Wait for him to recover*
ui.claus_trade_2024_squire.text: My gifts may be less flashy than the Commander's, but I'm sure you can find a use for them.
ui.claus_trade_2024_sergeant.text: If you still have ornaments after decorating the tree, I'll happily trade them for something useful!
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.0: Look at all these chests! I'll give you keys to them if you bring me Christmas wreaths. Ho ho ho!
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.1: We managed to take Plague Santa's minion captive. Talk to him to find out where they'll strike the next blow. And where to get hold of Christmas wreaths.
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.2: The Scrooge at the Camp of Scarlet Angels definitely has some wreaths. Where does he find them, the old fox?
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.3: Out in the plains and forests of these cursed lands, you're sure to find some wreaths. And lay some tortured souls to rest.
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.4: Sneak into the secret room of the dungeon of those traitors calling themselves the Forsaken and take the wreaths that they're planning to desecrate in their rituals.
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.5: The order of the Torturers has been in the thick of things too. Their dungeon also contains secret rooms, and they're sure to be hiding wreaths there.
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.6: Follow the ravens, but be prepared to defend yourself. You never know whether those crafty birds will lead you into a trap.
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.7: Bring me all the Christmas wreaths you can find. You still have many more chests to open!
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.8: Now, now, don't go too far. I need more wreaths!
ui.claus_trade_2024_claus.text.repeat: We need all the wreaths you can find to use as decorations. I still have more to offer you. Take a look!
ui.xmas_exchange_tree.text: Decorate the tree to gain boosters in Christmas events!
ui.xmas_goblin_torture_chair.hint: Select an event to get information about its location

ui.dungeon_challenges.spawn_started: Cocoons react to strikes. Rats are now emerging. You must defeat them quickly.
ui.alchemist_trade_v720.text.0: It's good you're here! The corruption has appeared again. Bring me samples, and together we'll stop the spread of the infection.
ui.alchemist_trade_v720.text.1: The best samples can be obtained from Corruption Roots. To weaken them, you must first destroy all the nearby cocoons.
ui.alchemist_trade_v720.text.2: Once you touch a cocoon, the entire root system will send defenders to stop you. Destroy all the cocoons to stop the reinforcements.
ui.alchemist_trade_v720.text.3: The air in the dungeon is toxic, so you won't last long down there. Keep track of time if you don't want to die from poison.
ui.alchemist_trade_v720.text.4: Look out for the Corruption Bearer. It's so distorted from mutations that after it dies, it explodes into pieces, and the corruption poisons anyone in the blast radius.
ui.alchemist_trade_v720.text.5: If you can't find the last cocoon, look where the rats are coming from.
ui.alchemist_trade_v720.text.6: You don't have to defeat all the enemies! Destroying the roots is much more important!
ui.alchemist_trade_v720.text.7: Thanks for your help. Each sample brings us closer to defeating the corruption. Together we'll put an end to this affliction!
ui.alchemist_trade_v720.text.8: This should be enough to make an antidote. You saved Lubenia. But if you find more samples, that will speed up the preparation of the medicine.
ui.chronicler_trade_v750.text: Bring me everything that belonged to the War Dogs. In return, I'll give you things that will come in useful in this forbidding dungeon.

ui.crimson_camp_kerr_exchange.title: Sebastian Kerr
ui.crimson_camp_kerr_exchange.text: Sebastian Kerr has arrived at the Camp of Scarlet Angels! Exchange the relics of the Order that scattered all over Lubenia for valuable rewards.
ui.crimson_camp_taskmaster.title:
Sir Rihardt
the Veteran
ui.crimson_camp_taskmaster.text: Sir Rihardt the Veteran has arrived at the Camp of Scarlet Angels. He's ready to generously reward anyone who can take on his exceptionally difficult tasks.
ui.greedy_jack_hw_v770.text.0: Don't be afraid. Come closer... Oh, you're not afraid. Good. That means challenges don't frighten you. Bring me Bone Powder, and you'll get a valuable reward!
ui.greedy_jack_hw_v770.text.1: Not bad. But not enough. I need more powder! At this time of year, it pours out all over the place... From the living and the not-so-living...
ui.greedy_jack_hw_v770.text.2: Still not enough! To the southwest there's an old village, Vilgraw. Since its death, it's become a harbor for the undead. And a mother lode of powder!
ui.greedy_jack_hw_v770.text.3: Not bad. But it could be more! The Cunning Scrooge is here in this camp. He's got more powder. Maybe he'll share his supply with you if you beat him?
ui.greedy_jack_hw_v770.text.4: Bone powder! More... more! Try checking the place where it's been piling up for years... Yes, the dungeon!
ui.greedy_jack_hw_v770.text.5: Good. More bone powder! They say that same dungeon has a secret passage that only opens for a short time. Try to find it.
ui.greedy_jack_hw_v770.text.6: You can never have too much powder! Actually... you can. For example, the masters of fallen orders do. I bet you'd produce some decent powder, too... But try to defeat them anyway!
ui.greedy_jack_hw_v770.text.7: Great! Heaps of Bone Powder! I still have some valuable artifacts though. Bring me all the powder you can find. You're not keeping it for yourself, right?
ui.dock_east_opened.text: The Scarlet Angels scouts discovered an abandoned dock. Perhaps an intact ship can be found there that will reveal a route to new shores?

speech.player.xmas.done: That was the last of them. Now I can claim my reward
speech.player.xmas.deer_death: I couldn't save all the reindeer. I'll prepare better next time
speech.player.need_horse: I'll first need to build a stable and tame a horse
speech.player.need_horse_near: Bring your horse to trade it for another
speech.player.home.low_lvl.1: I can't fight in these rags
speech.player.home.low_lvl.3: I won't get far with a weapon like this
speech.player.home.low_lvl.4: I can't get far on foot. I should find a horse
speech.player.home.low_lvl.5: What if I can still save them?
speech.player.home.low_lvl.8: I need to find some food
speech.player.home.low_lvl.9: Sturdy walls will keep me safe
speech.player.home.low_lvl.10: The light is my saving grace
speech.player.home.low_lvl.13: Hm, do I have a torch?
speech.player.home.low_lvl.14: I'll need an axe in the woods
speech.player.home.low_lvl.15: I should put a pickaxe in my bag
speech.player.home.low_lvl.16: I need to learn that design
speech.player.home.low_lvl.17: It would be good to check storage
speech.player.home.med_lvl.3: Is there any hope left in this world?
speech.player.home.med_lvl.4: They aren't people anymore. They're not people!
speech.player.home.med_lvl.5: I can hear, but I can't see them
speech.player.home.med_lvl.7: I think I hear the creak of a cart. Merchants?
speech.player.home.med_lvl.10: I should build a few more chests for loot
speech.player.home.med_lvl.11: Remember to replenish materials for processing
speech.player.home.med_lvl.12: I'm tired of walking, I need a horse
speech.player.home.high_lvl.1: It's time to replenish my Thalers
speech.player.home.high_lvl.2: It would be nice to go to the Northern Lands
speech.player.home.high_lvl.3: Time to go into the dungeon
speech.player.home.high_lvl.4: I don't remember life before the plague
speech.player.home.high_lvl.6: The most important thing is remembering what I'm fighting for
speech.player.home.high_lvl.8: A crossbow would be handy in the Northern Lands
speech.player.home.high_lvl.9: I need to plant more oats
speech.player.home.high_lvl.10: A leather pannier fits more stuff
speech.player.home.high_lvl.11: Maybe I should switch out my skills?
speech.player.home.high_lvl.12: Are there really no more books?
speech.player.home.high_lvl.13: How long have I been thinking out loud?
speech.player.home.high_lvl.14: The light can see I won't give up
speech.player.home.high_lvl.15: It's possible to survive even in the Plaguelands
speech.player.home.high_lvl.16: It's nice to be at home, in my castle
speech.player.home.high_lvl.17: Where are all these lepers coming from?
speech.player.home.high_lvl.18: When am I finally going to find this rare part?
speech.player.home.high_lvl.19: I should not forget to take food before going into the dungeon
speech.cursed_walker.trashtalk.3: They'll find you at the end of a trail of blood in the snow
speech.cursed_walker.trashtalk.5: This snowdrift will be your grave
speech.cursed_walker.trashtalk.6: If I don't kill you, the cold will
speech.cursed_walker.trashtalk.7: Can you feel the warmth leave you?
speech.rogue_santa.trashtalk.1: I have a present for you
speech.rogue_santa.trashtalk.5: I'll reward you with this sword... in your side!
speech.rogue_santa.trashtalk.7: Hurt? Let me put some ice on it
speech.rogue_santa.trashtalk.8: Like the costume? I took it off some old guy
speech.rogue_santa.trashtalk.10: This way! I found another one!
speech.rogue_santa.trashtalk.11: I thought you were just a story, exile
speech.rogue_santa.trashtalk.12: I'll turn you into an icicle!
speech.rogue_santa.trashtalk.13: You shouldn't have come when it was this cold
speech.rogue_santa.trashtalk.15: I like this costume – like blood on snow
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.2: I've come on the wind's wings
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.4: I can see both sides of the wor-r-rld
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.5: Tr-r-ry catching a snowflake with a beak
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.6: Why ar-r-re you looking at me like that?
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.8: Just don't cut down this tr-r-ree, I like it her-r-re
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.10: You could give me a Thaler-r-r. No? Oh well
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.11: A sleigh full of or-r-rnaments passed by
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.12: Someone hid or-r-rnaments in the dungeon
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.13: Did you see a fat man in a r-r-robe? He had a whole bunch of or-r-rnaments
speech.xmas_raven.trashtalk.14: Your-r-r neighbor-r-rs have alr-r-ready décor-r-rated their-r-r tr-r-rees. Go take their-r-r or-r-rnaments
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.1: Tell me, are you well acquainted with betrayal?
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.2: They left you, just like us
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.4: Where did you get that tiny armor?
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.5: Don't you understand where the real evil is?
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.6: You have the same power in you. I can feel it
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.7: I have no choice. I need to kill you
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.8: What's forcing you to take this path again?
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.10: Are you the one sowing death behind you?
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.11: Why are you here? For gain?
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.12: Look at yourself – you don't have a chance
speech.eisenhorn.trashtalk.13: My order is all I have left
speech.eisenhorn.atorus: You're alone, and I have my order. Atorus, you're up!
speech.eisenhorn.golund: Not bad, but not enough. Hold your ground, Golund!
speech.eisenhorn.gidur: You can't rely only on your armor. Gidur!
speech.eisenhorn.jaron: This changes nothing. Squash this bug, Yaron!
speech.eisenhorn_friend.trashtalk.2: I'll give my life for the master!
speech.eisenhorn_friend.trashtalk.4: You can't beat all of us!
speech.eisenhorn_friend.trashtalk.7: The darkness has always been here
speech.eisenhorn_friend.trashtalk.9: This dungeon is carpeted with the bones of heroes like you
speech.eisenhorn_friend.trashtalk.11: When will your kind calm down?
speech.eisenhorn_friend.trashtalk.12: Didn't I kill you already? You look so alike
speech.player.challenges_dung.locked: The door won't open until the Corruption Roots have been destroyed
speech.player.tutor.resources: I need to gather more resources
speech.npc.task106.s3: It's almost as if they were waiting for us. But how?
speech.player.task106.s4: Where's the cart with the medicines?
speech.npc.task106.s5: The cart is... Oh, no. More of them. Please, kill the monsters!
speech.player.task106.after_wave: Looks like that's it. I need to talk to the guard
speech.player.task106.s6: That was the last of them. How can I help?
speech.npc.task106.s7: It's too late for me. I've lost too much blood
speech.npc.task106.s8: Those medicines are needed at the haven. The cart is somewhere to the south
speech.npc.task106.s9: This is a lot to ask, but I have no choice. Save them, please...
speech.player.task106.complete: I need to return home and write a letter about what happened
speech.player.task107.before_wave: It's locked. The key must be somewhere close
speech.player.task107.after_wave: The key is probably on one of the dead bodies
speech.player.task109.s1: Who are you? Where are the survivors?
speech.npc.task109.s2: My name's Eliza. The disease... it took the others. It's just me now
speech.npc.task109.s3: When my husband and son got sick, I hid here
speech.npc.task109.s4: They scratched at the door, they tried to get to me...
speech.npc.task109.s5: I couldn't kill them. I didn't know what to do
speech.npc.task109.s6: Hear that? New infected. We have nowhere to run
speech.player.task109.s7: Stay here. I'll take care of them and come back for you
speech.npc.task109.on_wave: There are so many. You can't kill them all
speech.player.task109.s8: I think that was the last of them
speech.npc.task109.s9: More will come. You can't win this fight
speech.player.task109.s10: Let me help you. I have food and medicine
speech.npc.task109.s11: It's too late. Keep them for yourself
speech.npc.task109.s12: Leave me here. I need to bury my family
speech.knight.task1013.1: Looks like you haven't learned your place yet
speech.knight.task1013.2: I shouldn't have let you live
speech.knight.task1013.3: Are you mad about these weaklings' fate? Ha-ha!
speech.player.task1015.s2: Eliza? Is that you? What happened?
speech.npc.task1015.s4: I wanted to die. But the voice – it saved me
speech.player.task1015.s5: Whose voice? Who are you talking about?
speech.npc.task1015.s6: The Plague God. He explained how I can return my family
speech.npc.task1015.s7: And I understood. The plague isn't a curse – it's a gift. It's life
speech.player.task1015.s8: Look at yourself. You need help
speech.npc.task1015.s9: Help?! How dare you?! You serve him, too!
speech.npc.task1015.s11: Where do you think your power came from?
speech.npc.task1015.s12: The Reaping Night approaches. None of the humans can be saved
speech.npc.task1015.s13: Only those who give themselves unto the Plague God can survive
speech.player.task1015.s14: This isn't life. The plague kills people, it doesn't save them
speech.npc.task1015.s15: You will never understand! I won't be stopped
speech.npc.task1015.s16: I will never leave my family again. Never!
speech.player.task1015.s17: Why does the gray decay affect me differently? And what's this Reaping Night?
speech.npc.task203.s1: Who are you? Looking for an easy kill? Well, that's your mistake!
speech.player.task203.s2: I need to deal with the host first
speech.player.task203.s4: You raised your weapon first. Is everyone around here as friendly as you?
speech.npc.task203.s5: Most are. It's safer that way. What do you want?
speech.player.task203.s6: I know about the tourney. I want in
speech.npc.task203.s7: So that's why you're here. You think you can handle it?
speech.npc.task203.s8: I mean... you fight pretty well. Guess it's worth a rematch
speech.npc.task203.s9: Go back home. I'll send a raven with instructions
speech.npc.task203.s10: Мне понравилось сражение. Надо будет повторить.
speech.npc.task203.s11: As a reward for getting the better of me, take something from the chest nearby
speech.npc.task203.s12: Go back home. I'll send a raven with instructions
speech.npc.task205.before_battle.1: It's an excellent day to battle
speech.npc.task205.before_battle.3: Maybe I should try my luck in the tourney?
speech.player.task205.s1: I want to fight. Tell me the rules
speech.npc.task205.s2: You have to defeat three opponents
speech.npc.task205.s3: Fighting can only take place inside the stone ring
speech.npc.task205.s4: Leave the circle and you lose. Die and you lose
speech.npc.task205.s5: The victor wins a title and a reward
speech.npc.task205.s6: Those are all the rules in the Arena of the Dead. Enter the circle and we'll begin
speech.player.task205.s7: That was the last one. Time to retrieve your reward from Maret
speech.npc.task205.s8: Well done. The Arena of the Dead has a new champion
speech.npc.task205.s9: And, of course, your reward — take it from this chest
speech.npc.task205.f1: You left the Arena's boundaries. Too bad
speech.npc.task205.f2: Maybe you'll remember the rules next time
speech.npc.task205.1: Today, we have a new challenger for the title Champion of the Arena of the Dead
speech.npc.task205.2: Everyone knows the rules. Three fights. Three victories. Let's begin!
speech.npc.task205.3: Victory. But don't relax just yet. Round two!
speech.npc.task205.4: Another win for the newbie. But now they face our ruling champion!
speech.npc.task205.5: The Arena of the Dead has a new Champion! Talk to me about your reward
speech.player.task209.s1: Sebastian Kerr sent me. I'm looking for Rowen's orders
speech.eric.task209.s2: Ask Alef. He was the one who lost them!
speech.olaf.task209.s4: We found the letter with his orders, along with other valuables
speech.olaf.task209.s5: I loaded everything on the cart to sell it
speech.olaf.task209.s6: But when we stopped for some rest all that stuff went missing
speech.olaf.task209.s7: I'm positive Earl stole it. He wants to sell it quietly, so he doesn't have to split the profits
speech.olaf.task209.s8: I have nothing else to say to you
speech.player.task209.s10: Alef said you stole Rowen's things
speech.eric.task209.s11: Me? Ha! He probably just forgot to strap the sack down to the cart and it fell off somewhere along the road
speech.eric.task209.s12: Bolog always brings up the rear when we travel. If anyone found the sack it would be him
speech.eric.task209.s13: But he won't admit it if he did. That oaf only understands strength
speech.eric.task209.s14: Looks like you have a lot of free time
speech.player.task209.s15: As far as I can tell, you know where Rowen's sack is
speech.player.task209.s17: I'll find a way to get you to talk
speech.baleog.task209.s23: Earl make steal. Tell we share later
speech.baleog.task209.s24: I give to him, but no sharing. Maybe you make he sharing?
speech.eric.task209.s25: So, Bolog told you everything, huh. That moron
speech.eric.task209.s26: Well, you're not getting anything from me
speech.player.task209.s27: I'm not going anywhere without that scroll
speech.eric.task209.s28: You can stand there all day if you like. I'm not telling you anything
speech.eric.task209.s33: The plague take you! Fine, you win!
speech.eric.task209.s34: I hid the sack between two stumps in the Northern part of our camp
speech.player.task209.s35: Empty. But it reeks of liquor
speech.player.task209.s36: The tracks from Rowen's sack lead directly to you. Where's the letter?
speech.olaf.task209.s37: Ugh, fine. Have a drink with me and I'll tell you everything
speech.olaf.task209.s38: Hiccup! So... each one of us ended up stealing the sack? Ha-ha!
speech.olaf.task209.s39: I've got some good brothers. What else can you do?
speech.player.task209.s40: So you're brothers?! How can you fight like this?
speech.olaf.task209.s41: Ha-ha. I guess you don't have brothers, or else you wouldn't be asking
speech.olaf.task209.s42: Thanks for the story and the company. Take the scroll from that bag
speech.olaf.task209.s43: I'll split the rest with my brothers. Hiccup! Looks like we deserve one another
speech.npc.task215.s1: You came. I know you're angry
speech.npc.task215.s2: But I must show you the power that the Plague God can give
speech.npc.task215.s3: I called upon him because there was no other way
speech.player.task215.s4: Cut to the chase. Why are we here?
speech.npc.task215.s5: I have to show you what we're fighting against
speech.npc.task215.s7: You were fatally injured. I administered St. Peter's Tincture
speech.player.task215.s8: There are so many Night Guests. And they are far more powerful
speech.npc.task215.s9: That's what I'm trying to explain. The Reaping Night is almost upon us
speech.npc.task215.s10: Soon the Grim King will return and take what is his
speech.npc.task215.s11: We must stop him — whatever the cost
speech.player.task215.s12: Fine. I'll help. But don't expect me to trust you
speech.npc.task215.s13: I don't need your trust. I need your strength
speech.player.task303.s1: Enemies are approaching. I need to defend the shrine
speech.player.task303.fail: I couldn't defend the shrine. Next time I won't repeat my mistake...
speech.player.task303.win: That's all of them. The shrine is safe now. Time to go home
speech.npc.task309.s1: There you are. I propose a small contest to measure our skill as warriors
speech.npc.task309.s2: How quickly can you defeat your opponents?
speech.npc.task309.s3: Each leper is worth one point
speech.npc.task309.s4: Bears are worth three. And knights get you six
speech.npc.task309.s5: Victory goes to whoever earns the most points
speech.npc.task309.s6: Score higher than me and you win a prize
speech.npc.task309.s7: Looks like we've been spotted, and so the contest begins!
speech.player.frag.2: Almost fifteen. Are you keeping up?
speech.npc.frag.2: I already have ten. Trouble keeping up?
speech.npc.frag.3: I've already got a couple dozen. You don't stand a chance
speech.npc.task309.after_fight: That was the last one. Time to compare
speech.npc.task309.player_win.1: {0}:{1} I don't believe it! How could I have lost?
speech.npc.task309.player_win.2: Well, I'm a man of my word. You can take your reward from the chest
speech.npc.task309.player_fail.1: {0}:{1} Ha! Looks like I'm still faster than you
speech.npc.task309.player_fail.2: No need to be upset. Come back and you can try again
speech.player.task311.before: I can't rummage around here in plain sight
speech.player.task311.s2: I'm looking for the hermit. I need his help
speech.npc.task311.s4: But I think I can help you
speech.npc.task311.s5: Hey! Guys, let's show this one our hospitality!
speech.player.task311.after: I need to search for some clues
speech.npc.task315.s1: Your pursuit has taken you far from home
speech.player.task315.s2: I need to learn more about the Grim King in order to defeat him
speech.npc.task315.s3: Defeat him? Hm... I'll tell you my story and then you can decide how to proceed
speech.npc.task315.s4: I participated in the Imperial Lions' last battle
speech.npc.task315.s5: When the Blades and Crows betrayed us, I fell along with my order
speech.npc.task315.s6: I thought I was dead, but the Nameless God's adepts found me
speech.npc.task315.s7: They opened my eyes. The Reaping Night is a necessity
speech.npc.task315.s8: The Grim King will only take those who were supposed to die long ago
speech.npc.task315.s9: Those who prevented the prophecy from coming true. Those who went against a higher law
speech.npc.task315.s10: Once, the Empire fought against death, but it only brought about an even greater evil
speech.npc.task315.s11: You cannot defeat death. Sooner or later it takes each and every soul
speech.npc.task315.s12: Wait a minute. Do you hear that? It's the bandits. Your turn to help me
speech.rogue.task315.s1: I'll take care of you two lickety-split
speech.rogue.task315.s3: Run and I might let you live
speech.npc.task315.s13: Thanks for the help. I'm in your debt
speech.player.task315.s14: Then tell me how I can defeat the Grim King
speech.npc.task315.s15: You're a stubborn one, I see. But I'll answer your question
speech.npc.task315.s16: There exists a blade capable of hurting the Grim King
speech.npc.task315.s17: Marcus, master of the Dusk Blades, created and infused it with the Plague God's powers
speech.npc.task315.s18: Marcus seriously took up the annihilation of the Night Guests, but...
speech.npc.task315.s19: Whenever he killed one, two would take its place. The Nameless God is death itself
speech.player.task315.s20: This won't be my first time defeating death. Where's the blade now?
speech.npc.task315.s21: I think Marcus still keeps it close to him
speech.npc.task315.s22: But no one has seen him in a long time. Find Marcus, and you'll find the blade
speech.player.task315.s23: Thank you old... You don't look like any other knight. Who are you?
speech.npc.task315.s24: I was once the master of the Imperial Lions. Lord Iven
speech.npc.task315.s25: But now I'm just an old hermit
speech.npc.task315.s26: Go. If you need me, you know where to find me
speech.npc.task307.on_chest: I can't open the sarcophagus so long as the guards are alive
speech.aissa.trashtalk.1: I won't be running again. It's your turn now
speech.aissa.trashtalk.2: Why are you here? You already took everything from me!
speech.aissa.trashtalk.3: I don't fear death. I am death
speech.aissa.trashtalk.4: I will extinguish out your fire
speech.aissa.trashtalk.6: He will return. I can feel it
speech.aissa.trashtalk.7: It's too bad you'll die and miss the Reaping Night
speech.aissa.trashtalk.8: You will join us. Either in life... or after
speech.aissa.trashtalk.9: You think you've stopped the prophecy?
speech.aissa.trashtalk.10: My poor boy... What did he do to deserve this?
speech.aissa.trashtalk.11: The moon has risen in the sky, time for bedtime lullabies!
speech.hw.mansion.f1.1: What a marvelous home. Thank you for your invitation, darling.
speech.hw.mansion.f2.2: We wouldn't think of missing the annual masquerade.
speech.hw.mansion.f2.3: I love your mask, by the way. Is it a she-wolf?
speech.hw.mansion.f3.4: Yes. It isn't too scary, is it?
speech.hw.mansion.f1.5: Isn't that the point? Ha-ha! Where's this evening's host?
speech.hw.mansion.f3.6: My husband... he isn't feeling well tonight.
speech.hw.mansion.m1.7: Too bad. I hope he can join us later.
speech.hw.mansion.f3.8: I hope so, too. Please, come to the ballroom and enjoy the food.
speech.hw.mansion.f1.9: Quickly, now. All the guests are here. We need more food.
speech.hw.mansion.f2.10: I saw the host this morning and said hello—but he didn't ever register my presence.
speech.hw.mansion.f2.11: Looked right through me and kept mumbling something under his breath.
speech.hw.mansion.f3.12: Ever since his trip west it's like he's lost his mind.
speech.hw.mansion.f3.13: I don't know what he saw there, but he's starting to scare me.
speech.hw.mansion.f1.14: Hey! Are you cooking or gossiping? I'll throw you right out of my kitchen!
speech.hw.mansion.m1.16: A-a-a! My head is killing me.
speech.hw.mansion.m1.17: That noise. Where's it coming from? It can't be...
speech.hw.mansion.m1.19: I know they'd come for what's theirs.
speech.hw.mansion.f1.22: I thought one of the guests had gone to find something stronger to drink.
speech.hw.mansion.f1.24: What are you talking about? It's just a mask.
speech.hw.mansion.m1.25: I knew you'd come for the treasure. But you won't get them. They're mine now.
speech.hw.mansion.f1.26: What treasure? The one you brought back from your expedition? I don't understand.
speech.hw.mansion.f1.28: Wait. What are you doing with that knife? Please, no!
speech.hw.mansion.m1.29: Monsters! Evil beasts! Where is my wife?
speech.hw.mansion.m2.30: Ha-ha! Is this part of the spectacle? Very convincing.
speech.hw.mansion.m1.31: Where is my wife? What did you do with her?
speech.hw.mansion.m3.32: Wait, are you serious? This is a masquerade.
speech.hw.mansion.m1.34: You can't fool me! I'll kill all of you to find her! Die, monsters!
speech.hw.mansion.m1.38: I'm sorry I'm late. The monsters got to you first.
speech.hw.mansion.m1.39: I should have told you. The treasure I brought back... it was cursed.
speech.hw.mansion.m1.40: It's all my fault. I couldn't protect you.
speech.hw.mansion.m1.41: But I killed them. All those evil beasts.
speech.hw.mansion.m1.42: Others will come, I know. But I won't give up. I'll fight to the death.
speech.skeleton_boss.trashtalk.1: I'll send you to your grave
speech.skeleton_boss.trashtalk.2: Your soul will be trapped like the others
speech.skeleton_boss.trashtalk.4: We have plenty of space for another deadman here
speech.hw_hugin.1: I know many things that the priests of Harat don't even have a clue about
speech.hw_hugin.2: I can see you're trying to make your hut more livable
speech.hw_hugin.3: Great things are in store for me
speech.hw_hugin.5: Friend or foe? Who am I to you?
speech.hw_hugin.6: Try and find the secret of this land
speech.hw_hugin.8: We seem to have intersecting interests
speech.hw_hugin.11: The Forsaken have hidden raven feathers in the Dungeon
speech.hw_hugin.12: There are raven feathers in chests in the Grim Mansion
speech.hw_hugin.13: Find the feathers and I will readily reward you
speech.hw_hugin.14: Time is running out, bring me more feathers
speech.hw_hugin.15: There is no path for you back into the Empire
speech.hw_iven.1: Hear the voices of the dead?
speech.hw_iven.3: Don't fear the dead, fear the living
speech.hw_iven.5: Look into the beyond, what do you see?
speech.hw_iven.7: I hear the voices of my brothers
speech.hw_iven.11: Shobol gazes upon you through my eyes
speech.hw_iven.14: They are hiding Moonflowers in their dungeon
speech.hw_iven.15: We never found the Plague Coven's treasures
speech.hw_iven.16: Find Moonflowers and I will reward you
speech.hw_iven.17: Time is running out and I still need more Moonflowers
speech.player.dung.door_hero: Locked. I'll be able to return to the surface at the end of the floor
speech.player.xmas_bags.first_speech: I think I'm seeing bells. I wonder what happens if I ring them
speech.player.xmas_bags.bag_dropped: A chest fell somewhere nearby. We should hurry up and find it, all this noise will attract enemies
speech.player.xmas_bags.try_ring: It's dangerous to ring again while there are enemies close by
speech.player.xmas_bags.last_bag: Looks like that was the last chest. But I can come back tomorrow
speech.player.xmas_bags.end: Nothing else is going to show up today. It'll be worth coming back tomorrow
speech.player.xmas_bags.second: Hm, what if I ring again?
speech.xmas_goblin.1: Like my costume? My wife sold it to me
speech.xmas_goblin.2: Hurry up, I can't wait forever
speech.xmas_goblin.3: I see you eyeing this sack. It's mine!
speech.xmas_goblin.4: Don't hurt me! Oh, it's just you...
speech.xmas_goblin.5: I swear I didn't steal anything! At least not from you...
speech.xmas_goblin.6: Ergh, what a smell. Oh, it's me
speech.xmas_goblin.7: Your neighbor said their tree is better. Get your axe!
speech.xmas_goblin.8: You're not going to invite me in? What did I do to deserve that...
speech.xmas_goblin.9: Have we met before? I hope not
speech.xmas_goblin.10: In the Northern Lands? Must have been my brother
speech.xmas_goblin.11: I can sell you a bridle. But I left it in the Northern Lands
speech.dead_ruper_anniv20.1: You succeeded in solving all the trials and getting here
speech.dead_ruper_anniv20.3: I've collected some things for you in this chest
speech.dead_ruper_anniv20.4: You are our greatest hope for victory
speech.dead_ruper_anniv20.5: And, I fear, our last and only hope...
speech.npc.anniv20.1.1: Merchants used to wander on their own. But now, it's an absolute circus!
speech.npc.anniv20.1.2: Talking birds, resurrected corpses. I'm never going to get used to this place
speech.npc.anniv20.1.3: I used to hit trees with sticks when I was a kid, too
speech.npc.anniv20.1.4: What are you looking at? Is there an exclamation mark on my forehead?
speech.npc.anniv20.1.5: The grass used to be greener, and the dungeons longer
speech.npc.anniv20.1.6: Bring back the stutter st... Sorry, thought you were someone else
speech.npc.anniv20.1.7: I heard that only someone worthy can raise Eisenborg's axe
speech.npc.anniv20.1.8: What am I supposed to do with all these stockings?
speech.npc.anniv20.1.9: And that dude, Rupert... isn't he dead?
speech.npc.anniv20.2.1: I miss the days when merchants weren't so spiteful...
speech.npc.anniv20.2.2: There are often complications after suffering a severe illness. Death works the same way...
speech.npc.anniv20.2.3: Ever wondered where the direwolves leave to?
speech.npc.anniv20.2.4: I fought Huginn as soon as multiplayer launched
speech.npc.anniv20.2.5: I heard about this one guy, he sharpened a halberd five times
speech.npc.anniv20.2.26: А алтарей-то все больше и больше. И ни одной школы
speech.npc.anniv20.2.6: I've chopped down so many trees... I think one of them is out for vengeance
speech.npc.anniv20.2.7: I knew that dragons weren't real. This isn't a fairy tale after all
speech.npc.anniv20.2.8: There was a guy in red underwear who just ran by. Is he your friend?
speech.npc.anniv20.3.1: I found a Philosopher's Stone once. Turns out it was just a blood-stained cobblestone
speech.npc.anniv20.3.2: An Old Man was looking for you, mumbling about some knife. Oh, it's probably not important
speech.npc.anniv20.3.3: There were four of us, but one left to raid the dungeon in heroic mode with lowered health
speech.npc.anniv20.3.4: I just can't get the Kris from the dungeon. Ha, just kidding!
speech.npc.anniv20.3.5: Can I borrow a couple beartraps? I'll give them back later. Aissa won't wait forever
speech.npc.anniv20.3.6: Are you summoning rain to shower, too?
speech.npc.anniv20.3.7: The Forsaken Gatekeeper was considered a boss once
speech.npc.anniv20.3.8: Someone said Heavy Strike should be called Weak Strike, but I'm in no rush to change it
speech.castle_boss.trashtalk.5: I belong to the realm of the dead
speech.iven.task410_1.1: I have read the Grimoire Memoirs and I know how to return to the past
speech.iven.task410_1.2: You see... everything which has happened does not go away forever
speech.iven.task410_1.3: The events of the past live on in another world. The world of the dead
speech.iven.task410_1.4: I think that I can draw out one of the memories for a while
speech.iven.task410_1.5: I will show you the day that I saw Marcus for the last time
speech.iven.task410_1.7: But remember, I will call upon the forces of death to do it.
speech.iven.task410_1.8: And death has old scores with you
speech.iven.task410_1.10: Hurry. It is hard for me to sustain the memory
speech.knight.task410_1.3: Your emperor will fall with you
speech.knight.task410_1.4: The power of the Plague God is limitless
speech.iven_g.task410_1.2: What...what kind of monster was that?
speech.iven_g.task410_1.3: It does not matter. The Imperial Lions fear nothing
speech.iven_g.task410_1.4: A horn? Help is coming, at last!
speech.iven_g.task410_1.5: Marcus! It is you. And you brought the Dusk Blades!
speech.iven_g.task410_1.6: It is about time. We reined in Karn and his Dogs
speech.iven_g.task410_1.7: Plag and the Twilight Riders are attacking them from the north
speech.iven_g.task410_1.8: With your assistance, we can end this battle
speech.marcus.task410_1.9: Oh Iven, Iven, Iven. You are not even aware of what battle you are fighting
speech.marcus.task410_1.10: You chose the wrong side, you old fool
speech.iven_g.task410_1.11: The wrong one? Marcus, what are you saying? Look at these monsters!
speech.marcus.task410_1.12: These monsters are our only chance
speech.marcus.task410_1.13: Thanks to these monsters, I shall be the one who defeats death
speech.marcus.task410_1.14: Shh! I can sense your presence, Exile. You do not belong here!
speech.iven.task410_1.16: The Nameless God has felt your presence
speech.iven.task410_1.17: You are forbidden from being here. The past is fighting back
speech.player.task410_1.19: Marcus said that he would be the one to defeat death
speech.player.task410_1.20: I think that the blade is somehow connected to the Plague God
speech.iven.task410_1.21: It's worth finding out. Come with me
speech.iven.task410_2.2: The Dusk Blades fought the servants of the Plague God long before the epidemic happened
speech.iven.task410_2.3: But as a result of one of his trips, Marcus returned alone
speech.iven.task410_2.4: I will conjure up the memory of this day. I hope that it will be able to help us
speech.marcus.task410_2.7: This is where the missing villagers were last seen
speech.bot1.task410_2.9: Lord Marcus, do you think that the pagans were involved in this?
speech.marcus.task410_2.11: They truly did become bolder. Well, they will regret ever stepping on our land
speech.bot2.task410_2.11.1: And the missing villagers. What happened to them?
speech.bot1.task410_2.11.3: But... perhaps it is possible to still help them?
speech.marcus.task410_2.11.4: Did you not hear me? Spare no one!
speech.l1.task410_2.12: Marcus. Trying so fiercely to be the defender of the Empire
speech.l2.task410_2.13: But you are no hero. You simply love to kill
speech.l3.task410_2.14: Besides, with my help, you will be able to succeed
speech.l1.task410_2.15: I will help you defeat the ancient prophecy
speech.l2.task410_2.15.1: Your beloved Empire shall not perish
speech.l1.task410_2.18: I will give you a weapon
speech.l2.task410_2.19: Ssh! What do you sniff out, Exile?
speech.player.task410_2.20: The Plague God has used Marcus to fight the Nameless God
speech.iven.task410_2.21: People thought that they could use the gods
speech.iven.task410_2.22: But they became the pawns themselves
speech.player.task410_2.23: I want to find out where Marcus got the blade from
speech.iven.task410_2.24: Of course. Let me just take a breath
speech.iven.task410_3.1: Forgive me, Exile. Bringing up the past drains a lot of my strength
speech.iven.task410_3.3: But I will keep my word and I will help you
speech.iven.task410_3.4: I feel a mighty surge of power in this memory
speech.iven.task410_3.5: I think that this is what we are looking for. Take it
speech.marcus.task410_3.6: I forged this blade from the shards of souls
speech.marcus.task410_3.7: How many adherents of the Grim King are in it? Tens? Hundreds?
speech.marcus.task410_3.8: We killed you all, and now you serve a new master, ha ha!
speech.marcus.task410_3.8.1: It's a fine blade... but it needs to be fed with blood
speech.marcus.task410_3.8.2: Let the energy that flows around me be absorbed
speech.marcus.task410_3.9: Oh yes! I feel it. No one can stand in my way now
speech.marcus.task410_3.10: Not even the God of Death
speech.marcus.task410_3.11: Ssh! You are looking for hope in the past, but there is none to be found here
speech.player.task410_3.12: Marcus' blade is made up of soul fragments and is saturated with the Gray Decay
speech.iven.task410_3.13: That means that this poison has the potential to harm the Night Guests
speech.player.task410_3.14: But we still do not know where the blade is
speech.iven.task410_3.15: Oh... okay. I am just... going to have a rest
speech.iven.task410_4.1: I am tired, Exile. I have no energy left
speech.iven.task410_4.1.1: This is the last memory that I can retrieve
speech.iven.task410_4.1.2: Let us hope that it helps you
speech.marcus.task410_4.2: So, this is where it happened. This is where the Grim King was killed
speech.marcus.task410_4.3: I do not fear your ghosts. Show yourself!
speech.marcus.task410_4.4: Show yourself and I will jam this blade down your throat!
speech.marcus.task410_4.5: No. There are so many of you, why? I cannot lose!
speech.ng.task410_4.6: Ssh! Marcus believes himself to be stronger than death...
speech.ng.task410_4.7: Look what has happened to him...
speech.iven.task410_4.9: So Marcus has fallen. I am sorry, Exile
speech.player.task410_4.10: Marcus is dead, but the blade still exists in the Dead Forest
speech.iven.task410_4.12: Straight into darkness' embrace. Will you really not give up that easily?
speech.iven.task410_4.13: So be it. I hope that you succeed
speech.iven.task410_4.14: As for me, I need to rest
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.1: We have been waiting for you. For a long time
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.2: We know about you. We know why you are here
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.3: Marcus. The blade. You want to know where they are
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.4: We can help you, but first you must help us
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.5: We have been living for a long time. We are immortal. Like you
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.6: You know what it is like. Every day. It is the same thing
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.9: Relieve us of this monotony. Pass our trials. Our three trials
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.10: Yes, yes. Amuse us. And we will tell you what you require
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.11: The first trial will be simple
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.12: Strike everyone down. One by one
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.13: With each second that passes, they will grow stronger
speech.speaking_stone.task404_1.14: With each second that passes, you will become weaker
speech.speaking_stone.task404_2.1: You have succeeded. Weakness did not stop you
speech.speaking_stone.task404_2.4: You die. You rise from the dead
speech.speaking_stone.task404_2.5: They will die. They will rise from the dead
speech.speaking_stone.task404_2.6: But if you hurry, they will not be able to rise up
speech.speaking_stone.task404_2.7: Slice them into pieces. Slice them so that they all die
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.1: All the trials have been fulfilled. You have managed to alleviate our boredom
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.3: Telling you about the blade is simple
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.6: We will guide you. It is just one small adventure
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.7: You have had so many adventures. What is one more?
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.8: Your friend. The Old Lord. He possesses the power of the afterlife world
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.9: Yes. His sword will help you to see the past. Find your blade
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.10: It will show you the past. Through a ritual
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.11: The Grimoire Memoirs harbor the knowledge of this ritual
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.12: Yes. Find the Grimoire Memoirs. All the answers are there
speech.speaking_stone.task404_4.13: Oh, this will be interesting. Very interesting indeed
speech.kerr.task401.2: There are so many infected at the camp. I do not believe that this is a coincidence
speech.kerr.task401.3: I need your help. These provisions need to be delivered to the survivors
speech.kerr.task401.4: The horse is dead so I will need to push the wagon myself
speech.kerr.task401.5: Protect the wagon until we get to the camp
speech.kerr_percent.task401.1: They are breaking the wagon. Help, quickly!
speech.kerr_percent.task401.2: The wagon is almost broken. Stop them!
speech.kerr.task401.7: The wagon is broken, all the provisions have been lost
speech.kerr.task401.8: This isn't your fault. This battle was simply above us
speech.kerr.task401.9: Please deal with the rest of the infected
speech.kerr.task401.10: You did it! I shall forever be in your debt
speech.kerr.task401.11: I know that you're looking for Marcus. I shall make my way to the Order's library immediately
speech.kerr.task401.12: I will send the ravens as soon as I find the clues
speech.kerr.task401.13: Remember, this wasn't simply about provisions. It's about hope
speech.kerr.task401.14: And it is the faith that we can survive the war
speech.kerr.task401.15: I will send the raven as soon as I find the clues
speech.kerr.task401.16: Please, help me protect the wagon
speech.task_4_7_ground_01.1: Oh, how long I have waited for you
speech.task_4_7_ground_01.2: What is it? Pulsating and drumming inside your mind?
speech.task_4_7_ground_01.3: Do not fight it and it will pass. Close your eyes
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_01.2: Oh... you are in my nightmare, Exile
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_01.4: Ha ha ha! Not so fast. I have not played with you yet
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_01.5: Whoever you are, I will find you and I will kill you
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_01.6: Your tongue and sword are sharp, but they will not help you here
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_02.1: What? It's the same room, but... it's different
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_02.3: I will find the way out, you hear me?!
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_02_5.1: You repeat your actions and expect a different result
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_02_5.2: You know that it is absurd, do you not?
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_03.1: You will die and you will rise from the dead
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_03.2: You think that you can afford to be mistaken
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_03.3: But how many have suffered because of your mistakes?
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_03.4: How many have lost their lives because of you? For you?
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_04.1: You think that you will be able to bring the light back to this world
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_04.2: But each mistaken step just brings more darkness
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_05.4: This is what you are really here for
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_05.5: You do not really care for the others, do you?
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_07.1: Ask yourself what you wish for
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_07.2: To end evil and to find peace?
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_07.3: Or are you just looking for a new challenge?
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_07.4: Will you be able to live without an eternal battle?
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_08.1: You... you look exactly like me. Who are you?
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_08.2: I have taken the form of the person who has caused you the most suffering
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_08.4: I have grown tired of your games. I am going to escape this nightmare
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_08.5: You still do not understand. You live in this nightmare
speech.task_4_7_dungeon_08.over: Ha ha ha! It is not over yet, Exile!
speech.task_4_7_ground_02.1: I have to find the Grimoire Memoirs and hurry out of here
speech.trader.convoy.1: My brother is injured and hiding in an abandoned camp
speech.trader.convoy.2: I need to reach him as fast as possible
speech.trader.convoy.3: There are a lot of monsters on this road, but it's the shortest path. Help me defend my Cart and Horse
speech.trader.convoy.4: Open the gates once you're ready
speech.trader.convoy.fail.1: Everything is lost, my brother is definitely going to die
speech.trader.convoy.5: Oh no, the medicine was destroyed!
speech.trader.convoy.6: We need to hurry and get my brother back to town on the Horse
speech.brother.8: Thank you for your help, I couldn't have survived alone
speech.brother.9: I'm feeling much better, now my brother can take me back to town
speech.brother.10: You saved me, take what you want from my wares
speech.trader.11: You're our savior! I don't even want to think what would have happened without you
speech.brother.fail.1: You lost the medicine? I'm done for
speech.brother.fail.2: I survived all this time on just one hope...
speech.trader.fail.4: Leave me, I want to be alone
speech.servant.cult_1.1: Harat's Light will blind your enemies
speech.servant.cult_1.2: Accept your epiphany and praise Harat before it is too late
speech.servant.cult_2.1: The Plague God is strong and cunning, he will emerge victorious
speech.servant.cult_2.2: Do not resist, the Plague God will accept you
speech.servant.cult_3.1: The Nameless God has already written this world's fate
speech.servant.cult_3.2: Become one with the Nameless God, for death is only the beginning
speech.servant.cult_ally: Your help to our cause will not be forgotten
speech.servant.cult_enemy.2: Time has decided this battle. You have come too late
speech.servant.cult_2_enemy.1: Bow down before the Plague God!
speech.servant.cult_2_enemy.2: I will paint a circle with your blood!
speech.servant.cult_3_enemy.2: My lord will take your soul
speech.servant.cult_1_ally.2: In the name of Harat's Light!
speech.hw.coven.servant.1: Today we dedicate Adelia to the Plague God
speech.hw.coven3.brother.1: You will answer for what you've done!
speech.hw.coven3.servant.1: She has been granted eternal life!
speech.hw.coven4.brother.3: Become an acolyte of the Plague God?
speech.shaman_dung.3: I will offer your soul to the Plague God!
speech.shaman_dung.4: The spirits have foretold your demise
speech.shaman_dung.6: Do not fight against the gray decay
speech.shaman_dung.8: The Plague God granted me freedom!
speech.shaman_dung.9: The Plague God will rule again!
speech.dungeon.puzlle_key: You need 5 keys to open this lock.
speech.dungeon.puzlle_bowls: It looks like this door has a secret.
speech.torturer_dung.trashtalk.3: All will bow before His might!
speech.torturer_dung.trashtalk.6: Your skull will be my trophy
speech.torturer_dung.trashtalk.7: I am the Plague God's wrath!
speech.torturer_dung.trashtalk.8: The Light will not save you!
speech.torturer_dung.trashtalk.9: I am stronger than death itself!
speech.torturer_dung.trashtalk.12: No one will stand in my way!
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.1: I want to help you, Exile
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.4: An immortal ghost comes at night
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.5: The Night Guest fears only fire
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.6: You can find a special cache in the forest at night
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.7: To travel far, you need a horse
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.8: Get a direwolf to keep loneliness at bay
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.9: A direwolf will help you in battle
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.10: Books will help you develop your skills
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.11: Scrolls will teach you the history of the world
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.12: Don't forget to eat and drink
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.13: Some Exiles join forces in Orders
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.14: One day you will be able to win the favor of a god
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.15: Make sure to build a raven cage
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.16: Don't forget to read letters from allies
speech.miriam_npc.trashtalk.17: On the way here, I saw the homes of other Exiles
speech.leper_sacrifice.bound.4: Release me and I'll help you!
speech.leper_sacrifice.enemy.7: The Decay... will take us all
speech.leper_sacrifice.ally.5: Are there any more monsters here?
speech.leper_sacrifice.ally.6: I'll kill them. I'll kill them all!
speech.player.deer_carcass.used1: A large beast is somewhere close by
speech.player.chained_chest.locked: Chains can be broken with a lvl. {0} Heavy Strike
speech.neophyte.trashtalk.8: We all share the same end
speech.plague_priest.trashtalk.1: We have been waiting for you, Exile
speech.plague_priest.trashtalk.2: The Plague will soon consume you
speech.plague_priest.trashtalk.3: I can save what is left of you
speech.plague_priest.trashtalk.4: Bow down, and I will help you
speech.plague_priest.trashtalk.7: You're backing yourself into a dead end
speech.plague_priest.summon.1: Children of the Plague God, hear my call!
speech.plague_priest.summon.4: I will drink your blood warm!
speech.summoner.summon.1: Rise and serve the Plague God!
speech.summoner.summon.2: Death has no power over you
speech.summoner.summon.3: The hour of awakening has come!
speech.summoner.trashtalk.5: You shall serve a higher purpose!
speech.witch_hw_speech.1: What do you know of true beauty?
speech.witch_hw_speech.2: Hmm, looks like someone turned off the vibration...
speech.witch_hw_speech.3: To make my face beautiful, I need make-up
speech.witch_hw_speech.4: What do you think of my face paint?
speech.witch_hw_speech.5: It's time for a holiday ritual!
speech.witch_hw_speech.6: The amanitas have absorbed emanations of plague and death!
speech.witch_hw_speech.7: Do you have any problems with fresh amanitas?
speech.witch_hw_speech.8: Amanitas make my skin wonderfully pale!
speech.witch_hw_speech.9: All the knights will be crazy about me!
speech.witch_hw_speech.10: No mushrooms for you, they might kill you...
speech.xmas_dead_rupert.4: I'm back, and not with empty hands
speech.xmas_dead_rupert.5: The time of miracles is here
speech.xmas_dead_rupert.7: Lots will change in the new year
speech.xmas_dead_rupert.8: Pleasant surprises are in store for you
speech.xmas_dead_rupert.9: Can you find the secret room?
speech.destructible.weak_attack: Must be struck with something more powerful
speech.destructible.root_pillar_protecte: It's too well-defended. First destroy the cocoons that feed it
speech.camp_templar_npc: Complete tasks. May the Light lead you!
speech.camp_alchemist_npc: I need time to create my laboratory
speech.camp_battlepass_researcher_npc.ba: The hunt is over. We survived. This time
speech.camp_kerr_npc.interact: Not now. I'll tell you when it's time
speech.camp_trader_npc: I don't do business with outsiders
speech.magic_well_camp.success: The water is ice-cold, but I feel warmth. This well is blessed by the Light!
speech.magic_well_camp.cooldown: Enough for now. You don't want to make yourself sick
speech.harat_statue_camp.cooldown: One should not disturb the Gods that often
speech.harat_statue_camp.fail: The Light did not answer my prayer
speech.camp_scout.cooldown: Tomorrow, I'll scout out new locations. Tomorrow...
speech.camp_scout.fail: The eating schedule must be maintained! Come back later!
speech.camp_kerr_npc.2: Many more can still be saved
speech.camp_kerr_npc.6: I'm glad we can give people shelter
speech.camp_kerr_npc.7: My priority is protecting the innocent
speech.camp_kerr_npc.8: The scouts have brought bad tidings
speech.camp_kerr_npc.9: The cook can work miracles! Sometimes
speech.npc_chronicler.1: Oh, you don't look like one of them!
speech.npc_chronicler.3: Why does it always have to be ruins?
speech.player.harid_invulnerable: This defense can't be overcome! Change your target
speech.camp_scout.success: An interesting place is marked on your map
speech.camp_scount.1: I'll take you to where the ravens are circling
speech.camp_scount.2: You can try your luck once every few hours
speech.camp_scount.3: Sometimes it's impossible to find anything
speech.camp_scount.4: I found a hidden path. Come here and I'll show you on the map
speech.player.harid.1: I can't handle them all at once
speech.player.harid.2: I have to keep them from attacking all at once
speech.player.harid.3: Obstacles will help me outrun pursuers

item.tome01.name: Random Selections
item.tome01_page01.text: The Gray Decay, Corruption, Pestilence—there are many names, but the disease is one and the same. Losing their minds, men become monsters. They attack those who have yet to turn. The Emperor dictated to destroy anyone touched by the Gray Decay, though there exist cases when the Damned retain their consciousness. Some priests say this is a reckoning for our sins, others say it is a trial of our faith. One thing is clear: if the Gray Decay continues its spread—we are doomed.
item.tome01_page02.text: Brother Rupert, I pass the responsibility for our guest onto you. His body may be ravaged by the Decay, but his soul fights on. You are to take him to the Plaguelands and let the Light decide his fate. I, Sebastian Kerr, take upon myself the responsibility for breaking the Emperor's Edict to destroy all those afflicted with the Gray Decay. So no one doubts this, keep this scroll on you at all times until you have successfully completed the mission entrusted to you.
item.tome01_page03.text: The Order of the Scarlet Angels undertook the difficult task of establishing a library, the collection of which included multivolume works on the secrets of weapon mastery and healing, as well as numerous studies devoted to the Plaguelands and its inhabitants. Unfortunately, the library was looted in a raid, and many of the books are lost forever. Those volumes that remain, however, are greatly valuable.
item.tome01_page04.text: The priests of Harat used mysterious black stones known as "Soul Shards" in their rituals. Those stones contain the power bestowed by the Nameless God unto the Grim King's followers. With the help of Soul Shards, priests learned in mere moments skills and knowledge that otherwise took years of training and study to master. This may sound like the ramblings of a madman, but believe me, dear friend, I have seen it all with my own eyes.
item.tome01_page05.text: St. Peter's Tincture is one of the most incredible items in the Plaguelands. Many a life has been saved with this elixir. If you're lucky enough to find yourself in possession of this tincture, save it and use it only when you think you are in mortal danger. Just remember—even though this potion can heal the gravest of wounds, it cannot save you from the Gray Decay.
item.tome01_page06.text:
Sir Rowen, I'm happy to hear you've finally killed Rupert. Leave the last exile he escorted out to me. I'll send a raven with advice—hopefully, we can be friends. In the meantime, I have new orders for you. The Angels sent a cart with medicines to the haven. Intercept it. Without medicine, the survivors will succumb to the plague. The exile will understand later that it's a necessary measure.

Lord Huginn
item.tome01_page07.text: The adepts explained to me just how wrong we all were. We tried to fight against fate and only ended up making things worse. We feared the Nameless God, but he was right beside us. The Grim King will inevitably rise. The Reaping Night will come. And our world will once again be in balance. Life and death—one cannot exist without the other. Now that I understand, I'm heading north. I may be old, and my life may be waning, but I will spend the rest of my time in peace.
item.tome01_page08.text: Chief, some of our gang stumbled upon the old man. He's a dirty hermit, but he had a very valuable sword. The right buyer would pay a fortune for it. But the old man wasn't an easy mark. He withstood five of our guys. I barely made it out alive. We need to find him and finish him for what he did.
item.tome01_page10.text: From many, one. Cipher: Night Guest In Sorrow
item.tome01_page12.text:
A page from the Grimoire Memoirs

(The ritual of conjuring up images and events from the past is described here in an unknown language)
item.tome01_page13.text: Everything in the Plaguelands is different from the Empire. Here the Exile is free to ally himself with any of the Plagueland cults: Harat, the Plague God or the Nameless God. Through serving one of the battling sides, Exiles obtain special abilities that cannot be learned from any book. But don't think such an alliance is eternal, for even longtime enemies can sometimes become new friends.
item.tome01_page14.text: I am injured, but I managed to escape. Before they led everyone away... If I don't survive, at least this message will. Do not descend into the Underground Shrine of the Plague God. Do not search for it... What they will do to you would terrify even bandits and graverobbers. We were searching for the key. The key that opens the Dungeon of the Torturers will unlock a path to treasure. And we found it. But we didn't know what awaited us...
item.tome01_page15.text:
A man will soon be brought before you. He is one of those who call themselves Exiles. If you can completely subjugate the exile's body and spirit to the Plague God, we will gain an excellent weapon in the coming war. 
If you succeed, I will make sure you get more meat for your rituals.
item.tome01_page16.text: Levers... Each one affects the three paths of traps. But how do I deactivate them all? This strange fire quickly burned my predecessor to ashes.
item.tome01_page17.text: ...They've taken the mess hall and the second shaft. We've barricaded ourselves in, but it won't be long before they break through. The ground is trembling. That whisper... it comes from deep below. It never stops, not even for a second. There is no way out. It's coming...
item.tome02.name: Exile's Notes
item.tome02_page01.text: My name is Emil von Rott, and I was once a Knight of the Order of the White Shields. When I found myself alone in the Plaguelands—without a sword or my armor—my despair was indescribable. But I was able to overcome myself and slowly, day-by-day, learned the difficult art of survival.
item.tome02_page02.text: If you are reading the scroll, you must be an Exile. You are in the same deplorable situation in which each of us found ourselves at the beginning of our respective journeys. But you are not alone. Follow my instructions and you will someday be as experienced an inhabitant of the territory of sorrow as I.
item.tome02_page03.text: Before anything else, you must craft an axe and pickaxe to obtain wood and stone for manufacturing necessary construction materials. You can gather small stones and branches without them, but tools will make your search for resources faster.
item.tome02_page04.text: Don't waste any time, construct a reliable dwelling quickly! All you need is a few good pine logs. Strong walls will help you survive your first night in the Plaguelands and safeguard your goods from other Exiles. It's true that the Gray Decay has forced many of us to forget any good manners we may have had before.
