I am leaving my journal here. It describes all the rituals I could remember and all the symbols I could find. My name does not matter. But my work... Please, if you have found it, do not let it disappear.
item.tome20.name: Notes of a Sergeant of the Scarlet Angels
item.tome20_page01.text: Scouts report that a large force of barbarians was seen in the Plaguelands, led by the Priest. I'll move out with a small force to track them. We assume these pagans are from the same clan as the infamous Forsaken Gatekeeper.
item.tome20_page02.text: A horrible howl has been coming from the forest for the last several nights. My people are afraid to go on patrol alone. Some say they saw the tracks of a massive Direwolf. They have already started calling him Fenrir. But I'm afraid we don't have time for hunting wolves. I dispatched ravens to the Exiles who dwell nearby. Two have already come back with answers: Sir Sigurd and Lady Alicia have agreed to help the Scarlet Hunt and track down Fenrir.
item.tome20_page03.text:
We've heard no news from the Exiles who went in search of the Direwolf. I pray to the Light for their successful hunt.
Luck has smiled upon us—at dawn, our scouts intercepted a barbarian runner. We managed to learn a little from him: he was on an errand to deliver orders to the Forsaken. Takhal, Priest of the Plague God, who led the barbarians here, is gathering an army. The prisoner did not try to hide anything. He laughed and spewed curses.
item.tome20_page04.text: Alicia caught up with us today. Exhausted but resolute, she told us that the Exiles were in fact the hunted. While following the Direwolf's tracks, they were caught in an ambush. Sigurd was badly wounded and taken prisoner by the barbarians. Alicia barely escaped. She fears that the barbarians intended to capture them alive. But the Light is on our side. If we hurry, we should be able to save our man and thwart the pagans' plans.
item.tome20_page05.text:
We had to retreat. We managed to kill some of the cursed, but there were too many. The Summoner completed his ritual and disappeared, and the Exile... All we could do for him was end his life. Lady Alicia is blinded by grief and intends to go after Takhal alone. I was not able to persuade her otherwise, and I can't help her. We need to regroup and wait for the other forces from the Order before challenging the priest.
How could the Light allow such madness?
item.tome21.name: Accounts of Great Monsters
item.tome21_page01.text:
The people talk more and more of Great Monsters. A black shadow wanders through abandoned villages, white flames burn on the marshes, and the snow will not melt in the forests. These are all purported to be portents of the Fierce Freeze—an endless winter sent down by one of the Great Monsters. 
It may just be a legend dreamed up by peasants who have lived long years in fear. But even they are worth listening to.
item.tome21_page02.text:
Recorded from the words of a local blacksmith.
"It was stood on the edge of the forest, as tall as a barn. I just took one look at it, and felt a shard of ice in my guts. Well, I didn't hang around and wait to freeze to death.
Next day, on the road leading out of that forest, they found a merchant's cart covered in snow. It looked like the merchants had been caught by a blizzard and perished. But there had been no blizzard that night."
item.tome21_page03.text:
The records of the Order mention something that fits the description: Halt Coldbane, a pagan spirit that gathered the souls of those who died in the winter cold. Now this spirit is roaming the forests, bringing cold and death. Fortunately, warm furs can ward off even supernatural cold.
When you find Halt, send word to the Exiles and return to camp. They will deal with this monster, while we track down the others.
item.tome21_page04.text: Another home has been burned in the western part of Lubenia. Several Exiles infected with the plague lived there. One of them would sometimes come to our camp for help and supplies. It's unclear who burned the home down and why. This time, however, instead of regular human tracks, we found footprints that looked human but several times larger. What manner of beast is this?
item.tome21_page05.text:
"Flame cleanses the world, burning away all that is unnatural and might harm people." When I see what's going on, I recall these words from the canon I read as a child. More than twenty unlucky souls have been burned. We knew many of them, and we tried to help them manage the plague. Yes, they were infected, but their souls fought the corruption, clinging to the Light. They had a chance to resume a normal life...
 
I hope we can quickly determine who's behind this vigilante justice, believing themselves to be the hand of the cleansing flame.
item.tome21_page06.text:
We were wrong. This is no mere monster... He has finally been revealed: an enormous figure whose sword and armor seemingly forged from fire. It was Harid, Fire Incarnate, cleansing the world of anything that befouls it. One of Harat's minor spirits.
 
Could he have appeared here due to the Church's actions? Even if not, we must inform the exiles. They need to know what to prepare for.
item.tome21_page07.text:
Among the legends of the Lubenian natives, one is particularly intriguing—that of the Daughter of Decay who brings life. Her touch caused even barren creatures to begin breeding; it made plants grow many times larger and produce abundant fruit, and gave people second life after fatal injuries.
 
However, there is a second, less known part of the story. The animals were born mutated, the fruits of the plants were similar to flesh, and the healed people became... different.
item.tome21_page08.text:
The presence of the Daughter of Decay affected nature itself around her. In the places she stopped, thick underbrush grew, and the number of animals and insects increased. The very earth exalted in her presence.
 
But what happened after she left?
item.tome21_page09.text:
Vragna—as the Daughter of Decay is called—has not been seen for many years, so her existence was considered nothing but a legend. Recently, though, the natives have begun erecting altars and totems in her honor, and rumors are flying of Vragna's Handmaidens—a special group of priestesses that have been seen in Lubenia.
 
If she truly has returned to Lubenia, we must alert the Guardians of Purity. Who knows how close these stories are to the truth.
item.tome22.name: Camp Cookbook
item.tome22_page01.text:
You can brew Berry Drink with three hawberries.

Pumpkins that grow in the soil of Lubenia can easily and without extra expense be turned into Baked Pumpkin.
item.tome22_page02.text:
A piece of raw meat can easily be roasted to make a piece of Roasted Meat.

You can get a measure of Pure Spirit from ten holly berries.
item.tome22_page03.text: The seeds of agricultural plants such as leek, mandrake, pumpkin, and oats can easily be turned into Fried Seeds, which are a great way of keeping your hands busy and getting your strength up a bit. NB: You'll need double the amount of onion seeds compared to other seeds.
item.tome22_page04.text:
Even a normal raw leek can be fried to create a portion of fragrant Fried Leek.

A whole turkey is great for roasting.
item.tome22_page05.text:
To make Meat Stew a la Lubenia, you'll need two pieces of raw meat and two portions of fresh leek.
Another way of cooking Meat Stew a la Lubenia is to add one pumpkin to two pieces of raw meat.
item.tome22_page06.text:
To make a Mushroom Infusion, you'll need twenty grave mushrooms.

By mixing and roasting leek and oats, you get an excellent snack—Onion Rings.
item.tome22_page07.text:
One whole turkey and two portions of fresh leek can make a filling Turkey with Vegetables.
Instead of leek, you can also add pumpkin to your whole turkey and you won't be disappointed with the results.
item.tome22_page08.text:
Three portions of hawberries and three portions of holly berries make a fragrant Berry Tea.

Reboiled with the addition of two portions of water, one portion of Berry Drink can turn into two portions of Berry Drink, with very little loss of flavor.
item.tome22_page09.text:
Mixing Bitter Tincture with Mandrake Tincture (or vice versa), you get a portion of Monastery Tincture.

Adding Roasted Meat to Leek Soup will result in Onion Consommé.
item.tome22_page10.text:
You can get a fine Spiced Wine by mixing ten hawberries and two portions of incense in the correct manner.

Pour a flask of water into the pot, add a portion of fresh leek, and boil until ready. The result will be a filling Leek Soup.
item.tome22_page11.text:
Three gypsy mushrooms and two flasks of water can be boiled to make a portion of fragrant Mushroom Soup.

If you add a portion of Roasted Meat to your Mushroom Soup, you'll get what is known as Northern Soup.
item.tome22_page12.text:
Bitter Tincture can be made from a measure of spirit and five holly berries.

To make Mandrake Tincture, you'll need a measure of spirit and one mandrake root.
item.tome22_page13.text:
If you add some honey from a barrel to a portion of ale, you'll get good ole Mead.

If you add a portion of Berry Drink to Mushroom Infusion, you'll get Sweet Mushroom Tincture.
item.tome23.name: Tadeusz the Chronicler's Notes
item.tome23_page01.text: The story of the War Dogs stretches all the way back to the founding of the Empire, yet a large part of the archives is classified. The Inquisition goes out of its way to erase any mention of the fallen order from written record. This only reinforces the importance of my travels to piece together the true story! I admit, from my warm, dry archive, Lubenia did not seem quite this hostile... But there is no turning back. Onwards!
item.tome23_page02.text:
Though the purpose of my investigations is to reconstruct the story of the first order, I must start small. After all, what's the best way to eat a boar? One bite at a time.
The fall of the order is attributed to Master Karn, a violent hothead who succumbed to bloodthirsty madness and took his people north. I want to find out if this is true. Who was he, where was he from, and how did he come to lead a holy order? I hope my notes fall into trustworthy hands, or else I face accusations of heresy.
item.tome23_page03.text:
One of the exiles shared notes discovered in the abandoned Imperial library.
"During a campaign, a War Dogs squad was ambushed by pagans. Not only did the local guide not flee, he proved himself a capable warrior. A few brothers of the order owe him their lives. His valor so impressed the commander that he offered to let the Northman join the ranks of the order."
The description and time match. It seems that I have come across the first mention of Karn as a member of the order.
item.tome23_page04.text:
Another interesting fragment from the documents graciously provided by the exile <illegible>:
"Of all the new recruits, Karn has distinguished himself the most. The lad is strong as an ox, shrewd as a snake. He is second to none in dueling; even the order's instructors are hesitant to fight him. What he lacks, though, is diligence. He was barely able to learn to read or write. I hate to imagine what will happen when he must learn more complicated disciplines."
item.tome23_page05.text:
Another document fragment of considerable interest, which partially explains how Karn became the Master of the Order in such a short time. Only partially, though.
"The concerns about Karn proved premature. Yes, he quickly loses interest and is prone to fits of rage, but when talk turns to combat, a truly animal instinct awakens in him. He masters anything related to tactics in mere moments. He is the fastest to be appointed leader of a full squad. Impressive results."

quest.1_1.text: I hope the raven with my letter found you. The Empire has decided that this disease is your sentence. They were correct... at least partly. Death may have caught up with you, but then gave you back to the world. I know that you don't remember anything of your former life but understand this: you are in Exile here. Even death refused to take you. If you want to find your place in this new world, I can help you. I've put down a few pieces of advice for now. First, build a shelter. One doesn't appreciate the value of walls and a dry floor until they spend a night alone in the forest.
quest.1_2.text: Resources, weapons, provisions – they all have to be stored somewhere. It's dangerous to carry all your valuables with you in these parts, any items you lose out there might be gone forever. But anything stored in a chest won't go missing. Craft a couple of simple chests. I have no doubt they'll come in handy, and that you'll soon be needing quite a few.
quest.1_3.text: You'll need a lot of materials to outfit this place into something livable. You can't carry everything you need in your hands, so I suggest crafting a simple ragged sack. It may not be the most spacious solution, but the resources to sew it are quite easy to find. Flax Fiber grows everywhere, and you can pick up rope from defeated lepers.
quest.1_4.text: You've probably already encountered some of the less-than-friendly local inhabitants. Trust me, the worst danger only comes out after sunset. An immortal, ethereal monster hunts anyone wandering in the dark. Survivors call it the "Night Guest," and light is the only thing it fears. Fire won't kill it, but it will scare it away—for a time. Craft a torch if you want to live to see the sunrise.
quest.1_5.text: Here's my last tip: make a raven cage. It's lucky my raven was able to find you. To keep receiving my tasks, set up a way to send and receive letters. Send me a raven when you finish. And don't forget, it's not enough to just assemble the frame. You need to fill the inside with all the necessary materials, too.
quest.1_6.text: I received your raven and am glad that my advice helped you settle in this terrible place. I'm afraid I have to be the one who needs your help now. I recently sent a cart full of medicines under the guard of a trusted knight into the Plaguelands, but I never received word of their safe arrival. No news can only mean terrible news. A map of their route is attached to this letter. Go and find out what happened—don't worry, I won't remain in your debt for long.
quest.1_7.text: The guard said it was an ambush? Interesting. Looks like someone sent those lepers. I'll look into it. You, meanwhile, need to find that medicine. I marked the place the guard mentioned. Don't get your hopes up. Bandits or wild animals probably got it already.
quest.1_8.text: In addition to the medicine, there was also food in the cart. I think the local animals ate it all. The survivors at the shelter need food. I suggest hunting deer in the local forests. (To sneak up on a target, press the button in the lower right side to enter stealth mode). Once you get meat, cook it over a fire. It'll be enough for the survivors for a while.
quest.1_9.text: Great, you've got the medicine and food. Now you need to take it to the survivors. I marked the haven on the map. Just remember – they're normal people. If they die, they won't resurrect. They're weak and helpless, their only objective is to survive. But you and I are meant for a much greater purpose. Now go.
quest.1_10.text: It was too late—but it wasn't your fault. Those people wouldn't have lasted long anyway. Our world no longer accepts the weak—it turns them into something... different. Take yourself for instance. Every time you die, you resurrect—and your strength grows day-by-day. You have the power to change the world. Prove it! Prove that you're stronger than those creatures!
quest.1_11.text: Death might be a trivial inconvenience for you now, but you still feel pain. You need armor. Start with something simple. Sew some peasant clothes. Though cloth won't stop a sword, it'll slow the lepers' jagged claws.
quest.1_12.text: No one should fight alone. These lands have felt your might and it's time for you to start taming nature. Feral cats or savage direwolves alike need shelter, food and proper care. Give them that and in turn, they will give you their support.
quest.1_13.text: I've figured out who was responsible for the attack on the cart. His name is Sir Rowen. He abandoned his post with the Imperial army when the epidemic broke out. Ironically, it came for him soon thereafter. The Gray Decay only made him stronger, however, and he's starting to take over this area. To draw him out, you'll have to destroy the totems from which he draws his power—the corpses you see bound into trees. It's a terrifying, pagan ritual... but it's effective.
quest.1_14.text: If you die from every wound, you won't get far. Craft a few bandages. You'll need some flax and cloth. You might be able to resurrect, but what's the point if you can't survive combat?
quest.1_15.text: There's a graveyard to the north of you. It wasn't particularly calm before, but lately, there have been rumors of someone crying there at night. I know what it looks like, but you should still go and check it out.
quest.dung_1.text: Time changes everything. Rumor has it the vaulted halls of an old castle are now the Forsaken Order's lair. It won't be easy for you to find out the truth: the dungeon doors can't be opened without the key. However, the loot down there is plenty enough to live off for a while. Take a look when you have time.
quest.dinner_1.text: I don't know anything about your previous life. Maybe you're the son of a rich lord or a blacksmith's apprentice. What does it matter if that life is gone now? You're an Exile here, and you're learning to survive in a new world. It might not look like it, but it's a world teeming with opportunities. I'll prove it to you using the easiest, but a most important example—food.

quest.2_1.text: You now know that the Gray Decay is no ordinary disease. It originates from a higher power, revered as the Plague God in the human world. But do not be fooled into judging his deeds only by what you've witnessed. Your fates are intertwined deeper than you think. There's an abandoned library nearby. Search it for clues about the origins of the plague. I hope what you find will help you better understand my meaning.
quest.2_2.text: It's true, the Grim King is returning—and there will be no mercy when he comes. That's why I need your help. We'll need all the strength we can muster to survive the Reaping Night. To that end, we must continue your education. Try to smith a small dagger. Such blades are often overlooked because of their size, but it's often too late by the time someone notices its presence.
quest.2_3.text: You already know there are other Exiles living in these lands. Many of them act only in their self-interest and will, therefore, attack you without warning. Some of them, however, might help us in your education. I heard that Exiles sometimes hold fights to the death. I'll mark the residence of the person who organizes these bouts on a map. Only return victorious.
quest.2_4.text: It's not usually that easy to enter the tourney. But you proved yourself in our fight, so I'll make an exception. Competitors fight only by mutual agreement. We might fight to the death, but we respect one another. We're not murderers — we don't attack people in the back when they don't suspect it. If you come across that lot, prove to them it was a bad idea to attack you in the first place. Reach out after you've taken care of a few such unscrupulous souls.
quest.2_5.text: Respect is due where it's earned. All right, now you can participate in the tourney. There are three bouts ahead of you. Hold victory over each of your opponents and be named Champion in the Arena of the Dead — and receive a reward, too. I sent a map with our camp's coordinates. Bring your best gear; you're in for some heavy combat.
quest.2_6.text: Ever wonder why you always resurrect next to your home? Your soul is drawn back to the place of your body's first death. You are forever bound with it. Seeing as this will remain your home for all eternity, you should probably make it a nicer place to live. Why don't you craft a mat — it's better than sleeping on the floor.
quest.2_7.text: It's time to take care of defending your home against unwanted guests. Try crafting a few stakes and placing them around your home. It might keep your valuable discoveries from danger.
quest.2_8.text: Your home is the most important place for you to defend. Reinforce your walls and build new devices. You can cook meat faster or work multiple garden beds in a better-equipped castle.
quest.2_9.text: I've come to know about the "friend" you're in contact with. They are not the friend you think they are.
quest.2_10.text: Even though Huginn was trying to use you, he nonetheless prepared you well. Knowledge is our greatest advantage in fighting against the chaos that surrounds us. I'll pick up your education from here. First, you need to sew leather armor. It won't be enough to stop a sword thrust, but it can deflect cutting blows.
quest.2_11.text: At the height of the Empire, herbalists were famed for their potions. Only a couple of recipes survive from that time. To keep them from dying out, prepare a bitter tincture by brewing holly berries—it has unique healing properties.
quest.2_12.text: When the plague first appeared, the Empire's knights fought the infected and helped the peasants who lived here. But the disease took them one-by-one. Now, the previously-noble warriors prey on those they were sent to protect. Damned Knights cannot be saved, so fight them when they cross your path. There's enough evil in these lands already.
quest.2_13.text: The Order's scouts frequently spotted Huginn by the graveyard to the east. I don't know what he's hiding there, but I hope you can find out for me. Remember: graveyards are no longer the calm places they used to be.
quest.2_14.text: A long time has passed since people last heard about the Order of the Forsaken. It would be good if it stayed that way. We don't need another war. Head to their dungeon and stop them. The dungeon entrance is locked, so you will first need to find the Gatekeeper and take the key from him.
quest.2_15.text: I know what Kerr told you about me. I'll answer honestly: it's the truth—but not the whole truth. That fool doesn't know what he's battling with. Allow me to show you the truth. I will await you at a point marked on this map. Come, this concerns something far greater than you or me.
quest.altar_1.text: Carefully read all the books you can find on your adventures. They can teach you anything from how to better wield a certain weapon to exploiting your enemies' weak spots. But if that isn't enough... I heard that by breaking soul shards at an altar of Harat, you can further expand your skills and learn more. Be careful: soul shards are pieces of a greater, but very dangerous power.
quest.wolf_1.text: You succeeded in taming a Direwolf. Well done. But if you plan to seriously take up breeding them, you'll need a much bigger pen. You can find rare parts for it in the dungeon.
quest.sanc_1.text: My name is Alaina, but your name doesn't concern me. I know you were thrown out of the Empire and now you wander among ghosts and the damned. Do you dream of coming to the city, so you don't have to live every day, fighting for your survival – perhaps even exact revenge upon those who exiled you? I can help, but not for free. Here's my proposition: I'll get you through the gates, and in return you'll complete a couple of errands for me. Deal? Then you should build a Sanctuary. It will help you find other exiles who are also determined to return to the city.
quest.sanc_2.text: Did you finally build your sanctuary? Now you need to join an Order. I shouldn't have to tell you that the imperial guards are keeping a close eye on everyone they find suspect. Any papers that prove you belong to an Order will give you more weight. The larger and richer your Order, the more doors that will open for you.

quest.3_1.text: You may not trust me, but we have a common goal. We must stop the Grim King before he destroys this world. The Nameless God's adepts were last tracked to the eastern crypt. Go take a look. Search for any information that can help us. We're running out of time here.
quest.3_2.text:
If the old man you found in the crypt knows about the Reaping Night, then I will try and find him. For now, we need to continue your education.
You shouldn't plan to fight all your enemies hand-to-hand. It's often wiser to engage your enemies from a distance. Take the Plague Spawn for instance. They're especially poisonous creatures, but even a Simple Bow can easily keep them at bay. Now head to the dungeon and reinforce your theoretical knowledge with some useful archery practice.
quest.3_3.text: Exile! I hope your archery lessons went well. I need you and your bow right now. There used to be plenty of places of worship to Harat, but once the plague came, most were destroyed. I don't know why they're being demolished — but they're the only thing that reinforces survivors' faith. One such holy shrine is being destroyed right now. Please, go and defend it.
quest.3_4.text: You have to exploit every advantage in war — especially when the enemy is stronger than you. Start with the basics and set a trap. It might be simple, but it's also effective. Just be careful not to fall into your own trap.
quest.3_5.text: In its war against the Grim King, the Emperor's army scoured the forests in search of dark adepts. The adepts learned to slip under the knights' gazes, but hiding their belongings was more difficult. They called upon the Nameless God to create secret caches that are invisible in daylight. You can still stumble upon their enchanted сaches in the densest and most dangerous woods. Once night falls, go explore a pine forest and search for one of these secret caches.
quest.3_6.text: I heard about you defeating opponents with nothing more than a simple thill. But do you know how to defend yourself? Even a simple wooden shield has saved the lives of many skilled warriors more than once. You should learn to use one, too. By learning to bring it up at just the right moment, you can defend yourself from the most fatal of strikes!
quest.3_7.text: I decided to investigate the order's library to help you in your search. There's little information about the old man you're searching for, but I did find something. An ancient king's tomb. Kings used to be buried with their treasure and though I wouldn't have sent you to defile a sacred burial before the plague, you have more use for those treasures now than he ever will.
quest.3_8.text: Mandrakes are one of the most fascinating plants in the wild. Its roots are used in many pagan rituals, but we're interested in a more practical application. Mandrakes are an essential part of a special tincture that simultaneously heals and increases your attack speed.
quest.3_9.text: I can't stop thinking about our fight. I need to restore my honor and prove that I am a better swordsman than you. How about a rematch? But not just one-on-one. This time, I've prepared something a bit more interesting.
quest.3_10.text: You might have already seen other exiles' homes in the Plaguelands. Just like you, they often embark on adventures and leave their belongings unguarded. See where I'm going with this? The strongest survive. Take a couple of powder charges with you, they're great for opening locked doors.
quest.3_11.text: My labors have finally yielded their fruits. Scouts report seeing an old man wielding a sword decorated with runes of the Nameless God. That man could be the one you're searching for. He was last spotted in the Northern Lands. Saddle your horse and find the old man before someone else gets to him first.
quest.3_12.text: I'm sorry my information was wrong. I'll keep looking, but I need your help in the meantime. The Northern Lands are inhabited by dangerous flying dire bats. They're fast and poisonous. There's very little written about them in our records. Can you kill a few and describe their bodies and behaviors?
quest.3_13.text: The Northern Lands are rich in strong wood and iron ore. Seeing as you're already investigating the area, you should stock up on those materials. You can craft higher quality equipment with them, so be ready to get your hands a little dirty.
quest.3_14.text: Hm, your descriptions are pretty detailed. I'll study them, but I have another small favor to ask. The Northern Lands are home to many types of mushrooms. I'm particularly interested in grave mushrooms. Naturally, they're poisonous, but when properly prepared, they can be ingredients for antidotes. Prepare a few potions and report on your results.
quest.3_15.text: I heard you're looking for me. I also know you're not exactly friends with the local bandits. But I'm afraid they found me and are getting ready to pay me a visit. I have a proposition for you. You help me drive them away from my home once and for all, and I'll tell you whatever you want to know. Deal?
quest.horse_1.text: I bet you're sick of having to get everywhere on foot. A horse would help you get to far-off places much faster. But a good horse needs an even better stable. In its heyday, the Order of the Forsaken had its own cavalry—so you should be able to find some parts for a stable in their dungeon.
quest.horse_2.text: With your stable built there's only one thing left: taming a horse. In the Plaguelands, your best bet for finding a horse is by a broken cart. Unfortunately, their previous owners won't have any use for them. Horses are naturally skittish, so don't be surprised if you can't tame one on your first try.
quest.dung_2.text: The door to the dungeon's lower levels is locked, but there's no key that can help you here. It's practically impossible to figure out the secret to that door on your own, that's why you need to interrogate someone who already knows how to get in. There are Hermits who have been banned from the order. They aren't hard to find, but how do you make them talk? I can't bring myself to tell you anymore. What you decide upon can be on your own conscience.
quest.dung_3.text: If the Forsaken are really preparing for a war with the Empire, then we need to stop them. There's enough chaos between the two gods who are already fighting over this world. Do whatever it takes to stop Eisenborg.
quest.grind_1.text: You always need to be a step ahead of your enemies. Replace your gambeson with a copper hauberk. A bitter tincture is more useful in a fight than any bandage. And your sword is your sharpest argument in any fight. That's why you need a grindstone. Your equipment is no less important than your skill in battle.
quest.grind_2.text: Sharpening weapons comes with a certain risk. The more force you put into a blade when sharpening it, the more damage it can deal. But remember that blades with thinner cutting edges are naturally more brittle. You don't want to inadvertently break weapons when trying to make them more deadly.
quest.alch_1.text: Alchemy. There are very few who actually understand its laws. Alchemy is often compared to wizardry, but it's really a science—one that we have yet to fully master. If you assemble an alchemy table at home, then we can try our hand at a few experiments to broaden our knowledge.
quest.alch_2.text: Since ancient times, people have always wanted two things: immortality and riches. You're doing pretty well on the immortality front. Alchemy can help with the riches. Experiments don't always have guaranteed results, but there's always the chance that luck might be on your side.

quest.meta_1.name: Angels' Reward
quest.meta_1.text: We've had confirmation that the Empire sent a company of Iron Wolves to find a heretical manuscript. It is a history of the time before the rise of the Empire and must either be destroyed or brought to the capital. We think such an important document must first be studied before being thrown in the fire. We are offering a reward to whoever can find the manuscript. All the details can be found on the Exile community page on Facebook.
quest.meta_1.goal.0: Leave your home and head in search of forbidden texts:
quest.meta_2.name: Death Note
quest.meta_2.text: By the time you're reading this, the shadows have already reached me, I am dead. Our company of knights failed, but we managed to find a clue. A disciple we interrogated had the following ciphers: 4) herestowtforad 5) tupofuisffifbe 6) 4-21-14-7-5-15-14. He was also muttering something about scrolls. I'll send my message with a few trusty ravens and maybe you might solve this riddle.
quest.meta_2.goal.0: Find the scrolls hidden by the Grim King's disciples:
quest.4_1.name: Guardian Angel
quest.4_1.text: Exile, once again I seek your assistance. Ever since Rupert disappeared, I have had to rescue the survivors myself. Since the shelter is no more, we have been taking people to the Camp of Scarlet Angels. The other day, I ventured into the city to replenish our stores of food and medicine. Upon my return, I saw that the camp was surrounded by hordes of infected. I can't do this alone. Head eastward along the road and find my wagon. Hurry!
quest.4_4.name: The Trials of the Ancients
quest.4_4.text: I have not been able to find Marcus, but I know who can help. They are called the Ancients—immortal beings who have stood the earth since its creation. The Ancients not gods, no. They are observers, eternal spectators of the chaos which surrounds them. Only the Ancients possess more knowledge than that which lies within the library of the Scarlet Angels, but they are reluctant to share it. Complete the trials of the Ancients and in return, they will tell you how to find Marcus.
quest.4_4.goal.0: Pass the trials of the Ancients
quest.4_7.name: Mind Games
quest.4_7.text: I found information regarding Grimoire Memoirs. For many years, it was sheltered within our order's ancient library, which was destroyed. We sent knights to find the surviving tomes, but not one returned. I shall mark the place you need to travel to on the map, but I cannot tell you what awaits you there. Good luck, Exile.
quest.4_10.name: The Ghosts of the Past
quest.4_10.text: You succeeded... Well done. Perhaps your fight is pointless, but I will help you. You remember nothing, but believe me when I say that we fought. At first we fought the Grim King, and then the Plague. The mistakes of the past haunted us. We had to face the evil which we had summoned ourselves and earn the right to a second chance. But we lost. I have grown weary of war. I concluded that we could not atone for our sins. But what if I was wrong? There's a scorched clearing towards the south of your dwelling. Let us meet there.
quest.4_2.name: Professional Blacksmith
quest.4_2.text: A new day, a new battle. Gone are the days of running around in rags, armed with a stick. Your enemies have become stronger, your armor has become more robust, your weapons are sharper. Remember this and don't stop progressing. Your equipment has to be the best it can be if you want to defeat the gods. Demonstrate your skills on the grindstone.
quest.4_3.name: Teeth and Claws
quest.4_3.text: A sharp sword is good, but don't forget about your direwolf. It grows in strength with each new fight. Train it and you will gain a true beast to tear your enemies to pieces.
quest.4_3.goal.0: Deal 1,000 points of damage with direwolves
quest.4_5.name: Dungeons and Monsters
quest.4_5.text: The Grimoire Memoirs? It will take me a while to find them. In the meantime, I have a task for you. The Ancients host trials throughout Lubenia. For example, they will gladly make the entry to the Dungeon of the Forsaken more difficult, simply to see you suffer. The Ancients may not be able to help you in your quests, but a generous tribute will go far in your eternal battle.
quest.4_5.goal.0: Complete the first floor of the Heroic Forsaken Dungeon
quest.4_6.name: Ghost Vanquisher
quest.4_6.text: The minions of Darkness will continue to interfere if you do not deal with them. Yes, they will return, but each resurrection drains power from the Nameless God. The castle to the north is home to the whole order, together with the army of death. Their leader Rogvold and his ethereal warriors draw the life from everyone who comes close. But you ain't afraid of no ghosts?
quest.4_8.name: Dangerous Trade
quest.4_8.text: Excellent, you have found the Grimoire Memoirs. I will translate it right away and send it to Iven. In the meantime, could you please handle another request? We lost many other works about the Nameless God as well as the Grimoire Memoirs. One of these tomes describes the dark altar of offerings in detail. To recover the lost knowledge, make a dark offering and tell me what the result is.
quest.4_9.name: Alma Mater
quest.4_9.text: So, you wish to see the past with the help of my blade. How many times must I tell you that the Reaping Night cannot be prevented? As long as the Grim King's foster mother Aissa lives, I cannot help you. I do not possess the ability to control the powers of the Nameless God as long as I can feel her presence somewhere around me. Alas, not even you can defeat Aissa.
quest.grenade_1.name: Sharp Eye
quest.grenade_1.text: Aissa is dead? You never cease to astound me. Be warned, for even in death she can be dangerous. They say that her tears are incredibly poisonous. You know, I wanted to test a theory a long time ago. Mix her tears and the grave mushrooms on the alchemist table. An excellent poisonous potion can be made from these ingredients. Test its potency and then write to me about your findings. Naturally, I will pay you generously for undertaking this interesting research.
quest.grenade_1.goal.0: Hit someone with a Throwing potion 5 times
quest.goblin_1.name: Stealing from a Thief
quest.goblin_1.text: The Northern Lands have never had a good reputation. Bandits have always seemed to roam freely here. I do not care much for these barbarians, but I at least understand them. Murder and robbery provide them with the freedom that they desire. But among these lowlives is a creature that I cannot excuse. Hunched over, he conceals himself in the bushes, waiting for the end of a battle or haunting a wounded traveler, and then quietly removes every last thread from the deceased and flees. Find and finish this parasite.
quest.guard_1.name: Woodcutters
quest.guard_1.text: So, you already have the Order. Well, it is time to discover what you can do. I understand that one of the Plague Gods' descendants lives near you. It is an enormous, hideous tree which entangles fallen warriors in its roots and absorbs their strength. If you defeat it, you will prove your worth to me.
quest.eater_1.name: The Army in the Blade
quest.eater_1.text: You may have found a small but very unusual dagger in Aissa's area, it is called the Soul Eater. This special, ritual weapon can absorb the spirit of the enemies that were defeated. Each of these souls will make the blade stronger and stronger. I want you to try this dagger in action. You will witness a whole host of dead men fighting by your side.
quest.eater_1.goal.0: Deal 170 damage in one single blow with the Soul Eater
quest.wolf_2.name: A Four-legged Army
quest.wolf_2.text: Training is going well and the descendants of such wolves will be much stronger than their parents. Try to gather a few direwolves which are equal in strength to raise a strong companion for your travels.
quest.worship_enter.name: Choosing Allies
quest.worship_enter.text: It's widely known that three higher powers exert influence over the Plaguelands. Beware, you will soon receive letters from their emissaries. None of them will know that the others have contacted you. Do their will to obtain the favor of a great protector. Remember, however, that you can only wield the powers of one god. When you make your decision, know that the other two will consider it a betrayal.
quest.worship_enter.goal.0: Read the letter with a warning from a friend
quest.worship_harat.name: Harat's Gifts
quest.worship_harat.text:
You have been blessed with the honor to receive the gifts of Harat's Light! The Light is a true weapon in the hands of a valiant warrior against darkness and decay. To find the power within, prove your devotion by doing the Light's will. The Night Guests hide trophies in their wicked secret caches. Search one of these Night Caches and the Light will bless you.

Night Caches can be found at night in 3 Skull locations.
quest.worship_plague.name: The Plague God's Gifts
quest.worship_plague.text: The time has come to receive the Plague God's gifts. His powers of decay may change you. They will give you the strength to defeat your enemies. You must prove your devotion to obtain his favor — do the Plague God's will. Exiles are not subject to the Plague God's powers. Kill them, take their strength, and we will reward you.
quest.worship_nameless.name: The Nameless God's Gifts
quest.worship_nameless.text: Cleanse your mind to receive the Nameless God's gifts. Death defeats everyone in the end. To discover the strength within you, prove your devotion, do the Nameless God's will. The Plague God's perverse creations destroy the nature order. Kill the decay's minions called Damned Knights. Kill all that which belong to death.
quest.catacomb_enter.name: Home of the Damned
quest.catacomb_enter.text: Ancient forces have woken from their slumber. Can you feel them too? But maybe we will be able to use this to our advantage. Not long ago, the entrance to catacombs that were locked for hundreds of years opened again. When you hear their call, go to them.
quest.catacomb_level_2.name: Descent into Darkness
quest.catacomb_level_2.goal.0: Complete the 2nd floor of the Catacombs
quest.catacomb_level_2.text: Perhaps you should have been warned that traitors of other orders may stand in your way. But they won't pose an obstacle for you, will they?
quest.catacomb_level_4.name: To Each Their Own
quest.catacomb_level_4.goal.0: Complete the 4th floor of the Catacombs
quest.catacomb_level_4.text: Your efforts are commendable. While you fight, I have time to study the inscriptions on the walls. They are much more important than you can imagine. But admit it: you aren't leaving the catacombs empty-handed either. So go and get what is rightfully yours.
quest.poker_1.name: Card Game
quest.poker_1.text: Time on the road always flies by when you're in good company! How about playing a game of cards with me? For the sake of a good game, I'm willing to bet any of my treasures, even this extraordinary Direwolf! My cart is easy to find. I'll mark it on your map of the province!
quest.poker_1.goal.0: Play cards with the Cunning Scrooge
quest.poker_2.name: Card Hand
quest.poker_2.text: In this game, you need to make hands of cards. Each hand has its own name and its own reward. Try to make the Militia hand—that's when you are holding two pairs of identical cards. All you need is a little patience and confidence.
quest.poker_3.name: Test your luck
quest.poker_3.text: I love playing cards. Prove that you do, too, and I'll share both the contents of my bag and my secrets with you.
quest.friends_1.name: Find Friends
quest.friends_1.text: It's hard to survive on your own in the Plaguelands. You should enlist the help of other Exiles. Add at least one Exile as a friend. To find out how to invite friends, leave your location and select the Knights icon in the lower left corner. I'll show you how to get rewards with the help of your friends later.
quest.friends_1.goal.0: Add a friend to your friends list
quest.friends_2.name: Exile's Chest
quest.friends_2.text: Open the Exile's Chest in your friends tab. You must have 5 Exile's Keys to do so. Try to make an agreement with 5 friends to swap keys. It's free, and you can find lots of useful items in the chests!
quest.friends_2.goal.0: Open the Exile's, Knight's or Aristocrat's Chest
quest.friends_3.name: Knight's Chest
quest.friends_3.text: Open the Knight's Chest in the friends tab. It holds greater rewards but requires the same number of friends. Give your friends useful advice, and they'll quickly reach level 50, when they can give you the keys you need.
quest.friends_3.goal.0: Open the Knight's or Aristocrat's Chest
quest.friends_4.name: Aristocrat's Chest
quest.friends_4.text: Open the Aristocrat's Chest in your friends tab. You already know how it works.
quest.camp_1.name: Final Resting Place
quest.camp_1.text: You don't know me, but we have already met. My name is Sebastian Kerr. I am a commander in the Order of the Scarlet Angels. I ordered Rupert to escort you from the city. When Rupert failed to return, I resigned myself into believing you both were dead. I'm glad I was wrong. My squad set up camp near your shelter. We offer help to all who need it. Even if you don't need our help, come and pray for the fallen with us.
quest.boss_map.name: Hut in the Forest
quest.boss_map.text: A priest who is involved with a traitorous order lives in a hut nearby. Unfortunately, its exact location is unknown. To find the heathen's residence, you will have to track down a map. Follow the ravens, and they will lead you to the right place.
quest.kill_boss_1.name: Visiting a Neighbor
quest.kill_boss_1.text: You must slay the Gatekeeper. He isn't too sociable and will try to kill you. Show him that's a mistake. I have to test my theory, and you'll be able to loot his things. But beware: the priest is a strong fighter and has plague animals at his command.
quest.forsaken_map.name: Uncharted
quest.forsaken_map.text: I was right: his nature is like yours. He doesn't die permanently, but comes back every day. They say he's been seen with a map. Get it. Keep trying until luck smiles upon you. While you're at it, you'll obtain better equipment, which will come in handy.
quest.forsaken_map.goal.0: Unlock the location of the Dungeon of the Forsaken
quest.dung_open.name: Deep into the Past
quest.dung_open.text: At the heathen's residence, you should've found a key. There's a reason why they call him the Gatekeeper. The key opens the Dungeon of the Forsaken. Traitorous warriors await you inside, and they'll pose a serious challenge to your strength and cunning. Just think of the secrets they're guarding...
quest.dung_open.goal.0: Use a key to the Dungeon of the Forsaken
quest.build_strongbox.name: Bowels of the Earth
quest.build_strongbox.text: You already know the Plaguelands are teeming with all kinds of creatures. The most dangerous of them are the desperate souls willing to attack others for their own gain. Your castle is your fortress, but a hiding place can never be too safe, right? Build a basement. You'll be able to store all your valuables there without fear of robbers. Besides, it'll make your castle roomier.
quest.dig_strongwall.name: Extensive Development
quest.dig_strongwall.text: A hole in the ground is a good start. You already have somewhere to take refuge in case of danger. Try digging out more earth. Yes, it will require hard work and resources, but your reward will be a spacious hideout. Don't forget to reinforce the walls—you don't want your castle to come crashing down on you, do you?

tip.1.title: Your Stronghold
tip.1.text: Reinforce the walls to safeguard your possessions from the Damned and other Exiles.
tip.2.title: Your Stronghold
tip.2.text: Anything you leave outside your stronghold can be taken by unwelcomed guests.
tip.3.title: Night
tip.3.text: Fear the Night Guest standing in the dark.
tip.4.title: Night
tip.4.text: When leaving home at night, don't forget a torch.
tip.5.title: Provincial Map
tip.5.text: Explore the province to open up new lands.
tip.6.title: Dungeon
tip.6.text: A worthy reward awaits those who are courageous enough to explore a dungeon.
tip.7.title: Dungeon
tip.7.text: Using found maps, you can discover the location of dungeons which might hold a great variety of treasures.
tip.8.title: Food
tip.8.text: Berries and even meat can be eaten raw, but they satisfy hunger and thirst much better if they are first prepared.
tip.9.title: Food
tip.9.text: Hunting is a good source of meat, but you can't survive without a garden. Leeks also restore health, and you won't have to chase them.
tip.10.title: Food
tip.10.text: Don't forget to eat regularly, or you risk dying of hunger.
tip.11.title: Durability
tip.11.text: Keep an eye on your weapon's durability. You can't fight with a broken weapon.
tip.12.title: Resources
tip.12.text: Berries, small stones, branches, and flax fiber can be gathered by hand. Everything else requires tools.
tip.13.title: Water
tip.13.text: If you have a well, you can always fill-up empty flasks with water.
tip.14.title: Water
tip.14.text: Don't forget to drink regularly, or you'll die of thirst.
tip.15.title: Combat
tip.15.text: Enemies in heavy armor move slowly, giving you the chance to run away.
tip.16.title: Combat
tip.16.text: In combat your character automatically targets the nearest enemy.
tip.17.title: Stealth
tip.17.text: Lepers don't see or hear well. You can sneak past them.
tip.18.title: Weapons
tip.18.text: With due skill, pole weapons can keep enemies at a safe distance.
tip.19.title: Weapons
tip.19.text: You can use a torch as a weapon, but be aware—it will sooner or later go out.
tip.20.title: Manufacture
tip.20.text: The fire won't burn without firewood. That's also true for the smelters.
tip.21.title: Manufacture
tip.21.text: Not all the components necessary to produce certain items can be gathered. Some rare items have to be looted from enemies and chests.
tip.22.title: Manufacture
tip.22.text: With the right facilities, you can refine gathered resources into more valuable materials.
tip.23.title: Manufacture
tip.23.text: Place the mat where you want to appear when entering your home location.
tip.24.title: Manufacture
tip.24.text: You can see your available recipes in the smelter and other resource-refining facilities.
tip.25.title: Manufacture
tip.25.text: You can always speed up resource refining.
tip.26.title: Hunting
tip.26.text: If you can't chase down a deer, try sneaking up to it.
tip.27.title: Exiles
tip.27.text: The Plaguelands have taught Exiles not just how to fight furiously, but how to build strongholds, grow food, and make everything they need by hand.
tip.28.title: Gray Decay
tip.28.text: Not all of us have lost our minds. Not all the Damned turned into demons. But don't forget your sword when you leave home - and pray that night doesn't come while you're out.
tip.29.title: Ravens
tip.29.text: Ravens always circle over something of interest. And that which ravens take interest in will always be of interest for a lonely Exile.
tip.30.title: Raven Cage
tip.30.text: The quicker you assemble a raven cage, the sooner you'll have access to new abilities.
tip.31.title: Forest
tip.31.text: A great number of Damned hide in forests. The larger the forest, the more dangerous they are. It's important to remember that every trip for firewood might be your last.
tip.32.title: Traps
tip.32.text: Traps can stop Damned who have lost their minds, but they aren't a serious defense against other Exiles.
tip.33.title: Travel
tip.33.text: Build a stable to acquire a horse. Your legs will be less tired, meaning you'll save more energy.
tip.34.title: Travel
tip.34.text: You can traverse the province either by walking or running; however, running across long distances consumes a lot of energy.
tip.35.title: Auto Mode
tip.35.text: In auto mode, your character will gather resources and fight independently. They cannot, however, heal themselves on their own.
tip.36.title: Scrolls
tip.36.text: Scrolls will help you learn more about current events and about the world around you.
tip.37.title: Exile's Journal
tip.37.text: Use the journal to check available tasks or read any scroll you've collected.
tip.38.title: Quick Access
tip.38.text: Any item put in your character's pocket can be retrieved at any moment, as well as any equipped weapon.
tip.39.title: Night Cache
tip.39.text: Only at night in pine forests and stone cliffs can you discover secret caches with treasures hidden by the damned.
tip.40.title: Witch
tip.40.text: If a witch sees you, her screams will attract all your nearby enemies. Try to avoid her gaze.
tip.41.title: Raid
tip.41.text: To break into a stranger's home, you'll need to blow up a wall. The stronger the wall, the more powerful a bomb you'll need.
tip.42.title: Forsaken Gatekeeper
tip.42.text: You can locate the Gatekeeper's hut with the help of a map. Don't have the map? Search for it at Event Locations or in a Night Cache.
tip.43.title: Forsaken Gatekeeper
tip.43.text: The Gatekeeper is a strong enemy, safekeeping the key to the Forsaken Order's dungeon. If you can't defeat him outright with force, try a different tactic.
tip.44.title: Treasure of the Damned
tip.44.text: Ravens can direct you to a chest of the damned once you've reached level 23. When heading out for such an event, be prepared to fend of all the waves of the undead when you approach the chest.
tip.45.title: Poisoned Weapon
tip.45.text: This weapon's poisoned blade will gradually lower your opponent's health.
tip.46.title: Durable Weapon
tip.46.text: This type of weapon will last you much longer, which is useful for long adventures.
tip.47.title: Forsaken Dungeon Key
tip.47.text: To open this dungeon, you must get the key by defeating the Forsaken Gatekeeper.
tip.48.title: Dungeon
tip.48.text: The dungeon is home to foes stronger than any opponents you've faced so far. The dungeon is accessible for a few hours once opened, after which you'll need a new key.
tip.49.title: Dungeon
tip.49.text: The Order's most valuable treasures await courageous exiles at the end of every level.
tip.50.title: Shooting Bows
tip.50.text: Shooting a bow doesn't happen instantly. Drawing back the bowstring and aiming take time.
tip.51.title: Mysterious Chest
tip.51.text: Once every 2 hours you can open the Mysterious Chest in your "Resources" tab and receive a random bonus.
tip.52.title: Leather Pannier
tip.52.text: The Leather Pannier is a bit more spacious than traveling sacks. Take it with you if you set off on a long adventure or are preparing for a dungeon run.
tip.53.title: Traps
tip.53.text: When trapped, you won't be able to move and attack. Try to get free before an enemy finds you.
tip.54.title: Torture Chair
tip.54.text: Interrogate a Forsaken Hermit to access the entrance to second dungeon level and discover the shortest route to the treasure.
tip.55.title: Stable
tip.55.text: To tame a horse, you'll need to first build a stable. You'll find rare materials in the dungeon.
tip.56.title: Horseback Travel
tip.56.text: Before setting off for faraway lands, make sure your horse is fully fed.
tip.57.title: Horse progression
tip.57.text: The more you travel on horseback, the stronger and more durable your horse will grow.
tip.58.title: Horse returns home
tip.58.text: If you leave your horse far away from home, it will return on its own – and very, very hungry.
tip.59.title: Horse
tip.59.text: Not every wild horse can be tamed. Try your luck during the "Broken Cart" and "Pasture" events.
tip.60.title: Passive Skills
tip.60.text: Passive skills grant permanent bonuses to character's stats or provide a special ability.
tip.61.title: Active Skills
tip.61.text: Active skill can be used when you need it. Just don't forget to charge it.
tip.62.title: Active Skills
tip.62.text: Taking damage from enemies charges your selected active skill.
tip.63.title: Skill Books
tip.63.text: To gain a new skill, find its corresponding skill book.
tip.64.title: Altar
tip.64.text: The Altar allows you to increase the number of passive skills slots, as well as charge your selected active skill.
tip.65.title: Setting Traps
tip.65.text: Set traps to temporarily immobilize enemies.
tip.66.title: St. Peter's Tincture
tip.66.text: Drinking St. Peter's Tincture in advance will save you if you suffer fatal damage.
tip.67.title: Dungeon Traps
tip.67.text: Be careful in the dungeon! Carelessly running into traps can poison, immobilize, or slow you down.
tip.68.title: Castle Bonuses
tip.68.text: Each Castle Level you obtain comes with bonuses that allow you to produce resources faster and construct new buildings.
tip.69.title: Shields
tip.69.text: Shields increase your armor stat and allow you to block your enemies' strikes.
tip.70.title: Alchemist's Table
tip.70.text: With the art of alchemy you can learn to create gold, highly valued by merchants.
tip.71.title: Alchemical Gold
tip.71.text: Alchemical gold can be traded for unique weapons and rare skill books.
tip.72.title: Birch Cutting
tip.72.text: Birch Trees grow in the lands north of the river.
tip.73.title: Iron Mining
tip.73.text: Iron can be mined in the lands north of the river.
tip.74.title: Northern Lands
tip.74.text: You can only reach the Northern Lands on a hardy horse. And there's no way to survive in the north without one.
tip.75.title: Stunning
tip.75.text: A stunned character cannot move, attack, or use skills or items for a short period of time.
tip.76.title: Horse Trading
tip.76.text: You can now trade your horse for a horse of another color and level at the wandering merchants. Horses of a rare color have higher reserves of satiety.
tip.77.title: Exchanging Horses
tip.77.text: If you wish to exchange your horse for a new one, visit some wandering merchants on horseback – you won't be able to trade your horse away if you go on foot.
tip.78.title: Emotions
tip.78.text: You can now express your emotions in game. Do this by tapping your character in order to bring up the emotions menu.
tip.79.title: Customize Your Appearance
tip.79.text: To change your appearance or the sex of your character, click on the appearance icon found next to the settings icon at your home location.
tip.80.title: Rain
tip.80.text: Movement speed decreases when it rains. However, there is a simultaneous increase in experience, flax fibers, berries, and mushrooms.
tip.81.title: Pets
tip.81.text: In addition to sharp teeth, each pet has their own specific skills. The greater a pet's rarity, the more skills it can learn.
tip.82.title: Obtaining Pets
tip.82.text: You can obtain baby pets by finding them at locations, buying them from the in-game store, and by breeding adult animals.
tip.83.title: Direwolf Levels
tip.83.text: Wolflings grow quick when properly cared for, but to increase pets' levels you need to take them into combat with you. A Direwolf's maximum level depends on their rarity.
tip.84.title: Tiredness
tip.84.text: If your Direwolf stops attacking enemies, it's likely that they're just tired. To restore their strength, either return them to the pen or feed them wolf treats.
tip.85.title: Breeding
tip.85.text: After breeding, the male and female will return to the Plaguelands, but their offspring might be of a rarer grade than its parents.
tip.86.title: Commanding Pets
tip.86.text: Tap on your pet to open the command menu and choose your desired order.
tip.87.title: Pen
tip.87.text: The Pen has 4 levels. The higher the level, the more pets it can sustain, but each level requires its own design.
tip.88.title: Pen
tip.88.text: Don't forget to stock up on food and water. Hungry pets will become exhausted.
tip.89.title: Pet Skills
tip.89.text: To make use of your pets' skills you must either take them with you on adventures or order them to guard your castle. Certain skills only work with pets that accompany you.
tip.90.title: Breeding
tip.90.text: You can only breed pets of the same rarity after they've reached level 4.
tip.91.title: Poisonous Mushroom
tip.91.text: Don't eat just any junk: if you throw up, your food and drink stats will decrease.
tip.92.title: Greedy Hoarder
tip.92.text: In the Northern Lands it's said: lucky is he who encounters the Greedy Hoarder. Not everyone can catch him though.
tip.93.title: Traitors' Catacombs
tip.93.text: In your travels, you may discover a way down to the Catacombs. A reward awaits those who manage to come out of them alive.
tip.94.title: Your Order
tip.94.text: Join an existing Order or establish your own! Raids against bosses, battles between Orders and conquest of new territories await you, Exiles!
tip.95.title: Invite your friends!
tip.95.text: You can invite friends through messaging apps and play Grim Soul together!
tip.96.title: Aissa, the Great Foster Mother
tip.96.text: After losing everything she loved in her life, Aissa swore allegiance to death itself. In her new guise, she will bring about the Reaping Night.
tip.97.title: Aissa's Death
tip.97.text: Aissa's death will attract the Nameless God's attention. You are more likely to run into Night Guests but are also more likely to stumble across Night Caches.
tip.98.title: Breeder
tip.98.text: Talk to the Breeder if you want to teach your Direwolf new skills. He's often found by the Wandering Merchants' wagons.
tip.99.title: Exile Statistics
tip.99.text: Look at your victories and defeats, as well as all the locations you've explored in the Plaguelands, by tapping the Statistics tab on the Global Map.
tip.100.title: Fervent Places of Power
tip.100.text: You'll occasionally stumble upon Fervent Places of Power at locations with skulls. Interacting with them will temporarily bless you with one of several perks.
tip.101.title: Aegis of the Scarlet Angels
tip.101.text: The Aegis will help you make your survival more comfortable and add a few convenient functions to the game.
tip.102.title: Heroic Dungeon Mode
tip.102.text: Don't find this game challenging enough? Try exploring the dungeons on heroic difficulty!
tip.103.title: Heroic Dungeon Mode
tip.103.text: In Heroic Mode, the dungeon will be altered by various modifiers that will change with every playthrough.
tip.104.title: Heroic Dungeon Mode
tip.104.text: Dungeon enemies in Heroic Mode might rise from the dead.
tip.105.title: Dark Offering
tip.105.text: Every so often, Exiles stumble upon a dark offering altar. Place valuable enough items on the altar and perhaps some higher power might reward you.
tip.106.title: Rogvold's Shadow
tip.106.text: Rogvold was once the master of the Mourning Reapers order. Now he has been deformed into a massive, otherworldly monster trapped between the realms of the dead and the living.
tip.107.title: Thunder and Lightning
tip.107.text: When it's storming, lightning will occasionally hit the ground. You can escape its strike if you quickly run away from the area where it's about to hit.
tip.108.title: Neighbors
tip.108.text: The homes of your local Exiles regularly refresh on the province map. Don't miss your opportunity to clean out your neighbors' chests before they refresh.
tip.109.title: Neighbors
tip.109.text: Neighbors carry the keys to their most valuable treasures with them. Defeat them at skull locations and make sure to pack explosives when visiting them.
tip.110.title: Cults
tip.110.text: By completing missions, you may ally with one of the Plaguelands' cults to the Plague God, Nameless God, or Harat. Choose wisely, each gives special skills.
tip.111.title: Cults
tip.111.text: You may change cults, but remember: you can only use one cult's special skills at a time, and the points you earn for each are not exchangeable.
tip.112.title: Underground Shrine
tip.112.text: A special location where you can find a key to the Dungeon of the Torturers. But that's not the end of its secrets.
tip.113.title: Underground Shrine
tip.113.text: You'll need a map to find the Underground Shrine.
tip.114.title: Dungeon of the Torturers
tip.114.text: The Torturers are one of the Plague God's most dangerous servants. They present a much greater challenge than the Forsaken.
tip.115.title: Dungeon of the Torturers
tip.115.text: Take bombs with you when you head into the dungeon. They will help you reach hidden treasures.
tip.116.title: Dungeon of the Torturers
tip.116.text: The dungeon is full of devious traps that will cause inexperienced Exiles a great deal of pain.
tip.117.title: Dungeon of the Torturers
tip.117.text: To reach the final chest, you must not only survive, but also solve the dungeon's puzzles.
tip.118.title: Traitors' Catacombs
tip.118.text: There are several waves of enemies on each floor of the Catacombs. Defeat them all to go to the next floor.
tip.119.title: Traitors' Catacombs
tip.119.text: You have the choice to leave the Catacombs after every battle. But the more floors you complete, the greater the treasure you will receive upon exiting!
tip.120.title: Enchanted Chest
tip.120.text: Leave supplies in it to access them during a dungeon raid.
tip.121.title: Fight Together
tip.121.text: Your friends can help you collect keys that allow you to access valuable rewards. Don't forget to return the favor!
tip.122.title: Cultist Cache
tip.122.text: Watch out while treasure hunting—sometimes you'll find a path to a hidden dungeon instead.
tip.123.title: War Paint
tip.123.text: Unlock new character customization options and highlight your individuality.
tip.124.title: Resurrection
tip.124.text: The howl of an epic Direwolf, which you can acquire by playing cards with the Cunning Scrooge, can resurrect the fallen owner.
tip.125.title: Card Game
tip.125.text: Level up in cards to swap more cards per round.
tip.126.title: Card Game
tip.126.text: Level up in cards. For every 5 levels you gain playing cards, you get an additional reward.
tip.127.title: Epic Rarity Direwolf
tip.127.text: These extremely powerful Direwolves only gain unique, legendary, and epic skills. To acquire a wolf like this, play cards.
tip.128.title: Elements
tip.128.text: Armor protects you only from physical damage. Elemental damage can be reduced by armor with the right elemental protection.
tip.129.title: Elements
tip.129.text: Some enemies and traps deal not only physical damage but also elemental damage.
tip.130.title: Torture Rack
tip.130.text: Interrogate a Torturer Scout to access the entrance to the second level of the Dungeon of the Torturers and discover the shortest route to the treasure.
tip.131.title: Vulnerability to types of damage
tip.131.text: Some enemies are well-protected against physical or elemental damage. To defeat them, choose a weapon that deals the necessary type of damage.
tip.132.title: Blast Furnace
tip.132.text: Lets you smelt steel that is used to forge the best armor and weapons.
tip.133.title: Torturer Scout
tip.133.text: Scouts are frequently encountered in the north and near dungeons. To catch a Torturer Scout, use a Lvl 3 Scroll of Control on them.
tip.134.title: Forsaken Hermit
tip.134.text: Hermits are frequently encountered in three-skull locations. To catch a Forsaken Hermit, use a Scroll of Control on them.
tip.135.title: Cook
tip.135.text: With the Cook's help, you can make various dishes in the Camp of Scarlet Angels.
tip.136.title: Cook
tip.136.text: The Cook can make a lot of different dishes. You can experiment or find recipes.
tip.137.title: Scout
tip.137.text: Talk to the Scout in the Camp of Scarlet Angels. He can help you create complete maps from fragments.
tip.138.title: Scout
tip.138.text: The Scout in the Camp of Scarlet Angels can trade maps for food or other valuable items. Stop by often.
tip.139.title: Cat Levels
tip.139.text: Unlike direwolves, cats don't fight enemies. They gain experience by spending energy on useful effects.
tip.140.title: Location Maps
tip.140.text: You can use a map and trigger a game event at any time convenient for you.
tip.141.title: Location Maps
tip.141.text: You can get event maps as loot in game locations.
tip.142.title: Book of the Dead
tip.142.text: You can obtain the Book of the Dead by offering the Book of Fate at the Dark Offering Altar.
